summary: Multiple orb travel in different directions and appear and disappear randomly
description: Driving west on Weld CR 34 west of Colorado blvd/WCR 13 I noticed 3 lights forming a triangle just north of the moon but all moving in different directions. No blinking lights. They disappeared when I got to a stop light on I25 because the street lights were to bright. I continued driving and continued to witness random solid lights brighten or dim while moving in random directions. I turn onto 1st Street in Mead then turn West on Dillingham Ave and stop to look. I continued to see lights randomly. I park on to 2nd Street and watch between two trees the lights come into visibility. Some getting really bright others never getting bright but can be seen by the naked eye. I see many and decide to get my mother to see if she sees them as well. After explaining where to look and describing a few I see moving she starts to witness the lights/orbs. I took my Galaxy S25+ and start to film for almost 6 minutes. In the video they seem to blink but I was zoomed in and never witnessed blinking with the naked eye. There were some planes but they would have red and blue flashing light in addition to the white light. The orbs had no pattern formation and would come from the north, south or…

summary: Light coming from above and below it, hovered there with smaller lights move toward it, then it moved fast, turned dim and disappeared
description:
My husband and I just pulled in the driveway and were talking in the truck when I spotted this weird light to the right of the moon and just below a star or planet. It was hard to tell the shape, but it was emitting light below and above it and seemed to be a bean shape or cylinder. I pointed it out to my husband and started filming. The camera didn't pick up how bright it was. At first I thought it was a comet, but it just hovered there for awhile. We could see smaller lights that looked like satellites going toward it from the left over by the moon. Then I got out of the truck to see it better and as I did, it move fast over the the left above the moon and to the left of it. It got so dim it looked like an apparition, like a dimly lit cloud of smoke and the camera wouldn't pick it up. Then it just poofed out and disappeared.

summary: It was big . It scared me so bad.
description: I went out to check on the animals. Dogs were barking and horses were running. It was dark and not like them to behave that way at night. So i went out to look. I didn't see or hear anything. So i turn off the flash light and stood in the dark for a minute to listen. I didn't hear anything. So i was looking up at the stars when it happened. It was about 300 + feet hard to tell. It was about the tree line. It was moving so fast ,no light, no sound, it was black and blacked out the stars as it went by.. iI was big! and scared me enough to make.me cry. I couldn't really get the shape because it happened so fast it appeared to be like the shape of a blimp but not as wide. I could not get in my home fast enough. Where I broke down crying to my husband. Never experienced anything so scary..

summary: Two different colored lights encased in a cross-like mist formation
description:
Driving towards the Everett/ Mill Creek area past Silver Firs and a block of apartments, I noticed a strange light formation in the trees lining the sidewalk to my right. Thinking it was a strange dim light post, I was surprised to see it move out of the tree line and pass underneath the moon. There was on red light, and one white light. The red light was blinking. The two lights were surrounded by a mist or aura that was illuminated. The moon may not have been bright enough, nor the object high enough, for the aura to be ice crystals. It was about 47 degrees outside. After observing this phenomenon for several seconds, the red blinking light blinked out. The cross-shaped mist or aura remained and the whole thing kept moving to the south west towards Mill Creek proper. The object moved out of sight as my vehicle approached the Compass Church, with the Fred Meyer about one block away. I have heard while living in the Silver Lake area that strange phenomena are common, including strange aerial phenomena. Something besides test flights from Paine Field.

Starlink-356 (10-36)

summary: Stationary white orb giving off white light in an hourglass shape above and below, began to move, second white orb was moving with it

In the sky I saw a bright white light, it looked just like a star except it was exceptionally bright and appeared to be emitting white light above and below in an hourglass shape. Then my dog made a noise and I turned around for a few seconds to watch him. While I was looking at him I began to hear a sound like that of a jet engine, it began faint and got progressively louder. I turned back to the strange object and saw that the hourglass light was fading and then it began to move, its speed increasing as the sound increased. When it got over my property I could see 2 red lights. Not flashing. I live in a rural area on 2.5 acres. I kept staring for about 15 seconds to figure out what in the heck it was (a drone a super quiet helicopter?) and as i was staring at it, it morphed into a large bright circular orb. Almost looked like a jelly blob and then was a perfect bright circle. Before i knew it my property, deck and inside my home was lit up with a very bright light for about 10 seconds. Almost like it heat sensed? I panicked and ran in my home and locked the door. I saw it pass above my home and watched as it went towards town. It was long maybe a couple of car lengths or 3? I couldn’t tell if it was square shaped or cigar shaped because it was so dark. I have never seen a…

summary: Slow flickering lights that moved location spontaneously also would grow in intensity (brightness level) no reds no greens no structure
description: Headed on liberty pwky towards 291 hwy I saw lights that would slowly flicker brighter then duller until it disappeared and would reappear shortly after in a new location fading in intensity then growing in intensity only to fade out and appear in a close by location, I saw 3-4 of them essentially dancing or fighting. They did not appear to be planes or helicopters maybe drones but there is an airport nearby so maybe not. No red or green lights were seen at all. they would either slowly fade as they moved north or south or fade in a stationary position then appear in a new spot that was more north or south and higher or lower slowly growing its light intensity. Filing this report would serve as a good starting point to any investigation or justification to anyone else who saw this. I could not get my phone out in time to record them I was driving and I even rolled the window down to see it unobscured thinking maybe it was a reflection from my windshield, but the lights kept at it. it lasted only maybe 1-2 minutes. I was mesmerized so I didn't think quickly enough to film it. I wish I had a dashcam as it surely would have recorded it.

summary: After a mass shooting event I witnessed a UFO stalk a news helicopter
description:
Tragically there was yet another mass shooting event in Rhode Island which caused a news helicopter to circle or fly through the city of Providence.
A helicopter was just heading towards my apartment as I stepped outside. Fairly low. To get a better view of it I stepped onto my front porch steps. The helicopter made smooth and long right turn heading east, as I was watching it a bright light caught my attention.
It was a perfectly round, circular "orb" it was glowing but did not give off any light or halo. I believe this object was curious about this helicopter. I saw move at a fairly high speed in a very smooth and completely silent path directly towards a low medium sized cloud. I watched this cloud for what had to be 10 minutes before it drifted out of sight, anxiously awaiting for this Orb to move away from this cloud. It never did.
This was around 5:11 - 5-15 PM still fairly light out
From my perspective the cloud and Orb were only slightly higher than the altitude of the helicopters path. It was in my personal opinion following the helicopter, trying to be as sneaky as possible.
It's 2026. I know what drones are. I know what they look like, sound like, do, can not do. Why…

summary: UFO in local neighborhood
description:
As I was driving home from work I saw a flying object with green and white lights fly descending low to the ground. The object was heading east on E 87th street. At the time I was driving north on Andrews highway. The object was flying about 50 to 40 ft above ground and flew towards Lamar street, it was at this point where it began rapidly descending. It turned right and went south and I followed it. At this point I was able to get a good look at it and was able draw a picture from memory from my perspective. I was able to see the aircraft because the sun was barely beginning to rise and the aircraft was about 20 ft above the ground. There is an airport south of where this thing was going but I did not see it land. It disappeared from view as soon as I hit 86th street.

summary: Pilots observed bright luminous sphere with erratic movement over Bay of Biscay for 3 minutes.
description:
Ryanair flight FR1902 (Madrid-Dublin), February 16, 2026, 06:52 UTC. Two commercial pilots observed a single bright luminous sphere at approximately 46N, 8W over the Bay of Biscay.
The object appeared as a bright, self-luminous sphere with white/silver coloration. It exhibited unusual flight characteristics including:
- Erratic, non-linear movement patterns
- Rapid directional changes
- No visible propulsion system
- Silent operation
Observation lasted approximately 3 minutes before the object accelerated rapidly and disappeared. Weather conditions were clear with good visibility at FL380 (38,000 ft). Both pilots are experienced professionals.
This sighting occurred approximately 7 weeks after a similar sighting by TAP Air Portugal pilots over the North Atlantic (Dec 26, 2025). Technical report available upon request.

summary: Approx 1.55am on Feb 16, a row of 3 lights blinking horizontally, flashing white and blue, while moving laterally.
description: 3 bright "star size" round lights observed over Prescott, AZ, reported to move, in linear fashion, halt, and hold, then repeat. North-south lateral motion only. Blinking white and blue. Lights appeared fixed in relation to each other. Observed for approx 5 minutes. No noise reported. Guesstimate 1000 feet over ground. Sky clear with intermittent faint haze that evening. NOT Starlink. Husband came to get me as witness, but they were gone when we returned.

summary: A large solid white light roughly 1/3 - 1/2 the size of the moon(as seen from Earth) moving quickly, before vanishing from sight

While processing what I had just seen, and only a couple minutes later a helicopter of unknown origin passed through the same area I can just seeing this anomaly.

The first one moved from the constellation of the inverted L from the tip to further down, then another one passed from farther away from that constellation, crossing part of the sky, and at one point it made a turn without losing speed and continued straight, and the third one was slowly disappearing while changing colors, although the others also twinkled with colors and one with white or yellow.

summary: Object Moving from west to east directly overhead
description: Observed a white light moving from west to east directly over my location. Object appeared to be at high altitude; it was assumed that it was a satellite passing overhead in a ballistic manner. Then the object made an abrupt and fast-moving arching turn to the south, while accelerating at high speed. The color of the object then shifted color and turned red, completed the maneuver and headed straight west and out of sight.

summary: 2 bright erratic balls flashing on/off joining 5 colored balls lining up and moving as one
description: Starting 11:34 pm saw one bright light moving up down in the desert. Scottsdale/Rio Verde is a dark sky area. Another white bright light appeared moving the same way. They would go dark off and on. They'd get close together and pull apart. Another red smaller ball appeared and they moved as one in a line. Toward 12:30am a small blue faintly joined the line and moved as one. They were quite a far distance from me, lower in the sky. I stopped filming around 1:00am because I was cold.

summary: I saw a whitish light that was unblinking and made no sounds flying over the Zoo I work at. The same light I reported seeing 1/28/26.
description:
On the morning of February 13, 2026 at 5:50AM (PST) in Fresno, California, I was just passing that gate into the headquarters at my work when I felt like I was being watched as if there was a pressure on the back of my shoulders. The word "Watcher" came to my mind for some reason and I turned around. I saw a light traveling from a northern direction towards me. It hovered above a few if the animal exhibits at the Fresno Chaffee Zoo, the Flamingo and the Stingray Bay exhibits. It flew at a steady speed (similar to a helicopter) and at angle of 70 degrees from my perspective. It might have been flying 200-300ft above the zoo. It flew towards the east and remained in a linear flight path. It was unnlinking, but seemed to morph and pulsate. The light would have been the size of quarter if I held out my arm at full extension. It appeared mostly whitish, but closer pictures and snapshots of my video I took on my phone of the object reveal a spiking shape and translucent white exterior with pinkish and blue hues. It remains round but slightly spikey, like a star. Eventually, it passed out of view in the distance. It never made an sound, no humming.
Another witness watched it disappear…

summary: A dim fast object that smoothly curved east to south without slowing—too fast for normal flight.
description: This morning as I was getting ready for work I stepped out onto my deck to check on the deer that hang around and I always look up at the dark sky because I’ve had 5 sightings now and after that first one you start paying attention. Anyway I saw a couple of what I am pretty sure are satellites they usually are going from west to east and have a slight blue color or white and more at a constant speed. I also noticed one going from south to north and it was a little brighter than most so I grabbed my 12x50 binoculars to check it out as I was following it into my field of view came a very dimly lit white object moving about the speed of a shooting star but not as bright. After about 2 seconds it made a very smooth curving turn from east to the south without slowing down at all and I couldn’t see it after that. Whatever it was it was going way to fast to make that turn.

summary: Perfectly vertical amber sliver hanging in the sky
description:
While walking the dogs tonight with my wife, I stared into the sky in front us and tried to figure out what was hanging in the sky above the tree. There is a radio tower nearby and I initially thought we were seeing an antenna panel from it but I realized the tower was off to the right and plainly visible.
I saw a perfectly vertical, amber light or rod. The light was not brilliant, which explains why I thought it was a panel visible from reflected light from below. It stayed completely stationary and I watched it from that position for well over five minutes.
I've seen a variety of things in the skies in my life and was a trained aircraft spotter in the Navy. This defied all explanation. There were no recent rocket launches. No Starlink releases today/tonight. Not ISS. It was not ice crystals or a sundog as sunset was an hour prior and it was 46 F. Not a plane or a drone. It didn't even look like the UFOs I have seen. A perfectly vertical amber line in the sky.
The streak was roughly the length of my thumb width held at arm's length.

summary: It had a very small jet engine, it was a very distinct sound but cloaked to look like birds flying.
description: I was shooting my bow, my wife was with me, she heard it and saw it too. You could clearly tell by the sound of the jet engine that it was right there, my best way of explaining this is that it was cloaked. It blended in with the sky and projected an image of birds flying. I thought the birds were chasing it at first but the birds that were started by the object appearing and flying so low above the trees settled back down and landed again after it had gotten out of our view. I remember two or three birds continuing at a high rate of speed, approx 25-30 mph in an west to easterly direction, but the birds were EXACTLY where the small jet engine noise was coming from. I remember thinking it weird that birds would chase something so loud and fast and it dawned on me the sky looked weird around them. My best guess is the craft itself was projecting an image of these birds to hide itself. I have never seen a drone this advanced and I felt I needed to report it. It flew right over our heads but was camoflaged somehow to look like sky and birds flying. It was too close to the tree tops to see for long, but my wife said she heard it accelerate after it went from view.

All objects were oriented in the same direction and appeared identical in shape and size. Perfect rectangles. Short sides top and bottom. I observed at least four small rectangular objects (more like ladders) high in the night sky while looking west/southwest from Black Diamond, WA. All objects were oriented in the same direction and appeared identical in shape and size. Perfect rectangles. Short sides top and bottom. They did not change color, but they ‘twinkled’ in the same way stars do. The sky was completely clear and cloudless, providing excellent visibility. The objects appeared stationary or nearly stationary and remained visible for at least 57 minutes, continuing to be present at 12:27 AM. They stayed fixed relative to one another the entire time. They were silent and did not resemble aircraft, drones, satellites, or typical astronomical objects.” Each is at a different angle of elevation; one at 20 degrees, one straight above it at maybe 40, another quite to the right of those at 65 and another quite to the right of that at maybe 50 degrees. summary: AP - Bright White Light Moving Southeast - Dissapear then Reappears.
description: This is my second sighting in the same area. I was looking west toward downtown Jacksonville. If you look at a map, I would estimate that it was over the Saint John's River, which is 3 miles from my location. The object is moving southeast and it's about 30 degrees. It was moving as fast as a small aircraft, but it was much brighter. It disappears for a few seconds. I spot it again, now at about 70 degrees and moving up, going west at a very high rate of speed. I'd say it was moving faster than a SpaceX rocket. It's a lot farther away at this point and it slowly disappears in the sky. I waited another 5 minutes or so, and another (the same?) bright light appears just a bit North of the first sighting at about 30 degrees. It hung around for 10 seconds or so and disappeared. And of course, I have no recording of this event. I will try better next time.

summary: My husband and I saw two shiny metallic objects shining in the distant sky.
description: My husband and I saw what appeared to be two shiny objects in the distant sky. We used binoculars to get a better view. They appeared to be metallic structures. If I had to choose a shape, I would say a hand-lifting weight, two larger parts at the ends connected by a straight portion. It was not a circle. It wasn't possible to see much detail. After about 20 minutes, the images appeared to have moved on. It's possible they were moving when we saw them, but it didn't appear so. I am 77 and my husband is 75. My husband was an airline mechanic and I was a paralegal.

summary: 3 bright lights, curved in a line. Hovering for over 20 minutes in the same spot. They would switch spots and hover. Bright to dim
description:
We were driving on hwy 14 east towards hwy 85 in between county roads 29 and 27, I think. Then we looked towards Loveland/Denver/ South and we saw 1 really bright light, looking like it was carrying, other bright light. I say, hey whats that, and as were looking on, they seperate into a uniformed curved line. Then they begin to get very bright and some dim at the same time. All while in this curved line for like 10 minutes. At this point I had pulled over and were facing the 3 lights. So, the light on the right of this curved line, dims itself and drops down below the other 2 lights and starts moving to the left and under the other 2 and then gets back into the lone but on the left side! Then it brightens up again. They stayed like this for 5 minutes and the light that was the middle light but now is the right light (bc the other light moved to the left) decides to do the same move as the 1st bright light. Its so hard to explain. I hope someone else saw this!

summary: High speed object resembling boomerang headed east from my location
description:
The object resembled a falcon diving from a high altitude, but this was not a falcon. It was white as snow and had no sound, and was moving easily 30mph towards Columbus Georgia from my location.
The object was almost translucent and somewhat reflective because as it flew out of view it was like a shining dot in the sky. It was at 1500-2000 feet from the ground.
I’m a retired combat vet that worked with drones in Iraq and this was like nothing I’ve seen. The rate of speed and lack of sound was noted were close to an airport and Fort Benning.

summary: Cluster of UFOs, DANGEROUSLY close to each other, straightening into a line, then breaking back into a tight cluster, fading in/out.
description: Leaving my home, I saw a cluster of UFOs. I saw roughly 15-20 of them. They would fade in and out of view. Hovering in one spot of the sky, unchanging. The "flight" formation changed often. From hovering in place closely together, to lining up, as if almost touching each other. Just a straight line in the sky. Then, they'd "burst" apart, over and over this would happen. They were not fighting. There was a lack of speed but they did not fly like a plane, helicopter or drone. They did NOT have wings, trails, or anything. In the sunshine they genuinely looked like crosses but it could have been the glare from the sun. They were VERY high in altitude. I have never seen such a thing before. They moved and changed like nothing I had ever seen any human create on Earth. I was VERY, VERY, VERY far away from this, but I just so happened to see it while driving.

summary: Triangle craft hovering low over road
description:
My fiancée and I were driving and he leaned forward looking up so I did the same. He said what is that and I had no idea…we had time to take a good look approaching and this light was BRIGHT I cannot stress that enough. I thought possibly it was a helicopter but it was just far too bright and it just was not making sense as we got closer…I rolled my window down and looked up at it directly above the car. It was difficult to even comprehend what I was seeing…it was a triangle hovering low…as in stationary and not moving at all above us. There were lights at each corner and not flashing like a plane. I looked up at it for enough time to really take it in and what was baffling was there was nothing to take in. I did not see any form of seams or identifying information…no wings, no engine or propulsion methods visible….and zero sound. It was silent.
Of course I am screaming stop the car and he does not do so but I have him turn around and it was just gone. I am so glad someone else saw it with me so I don’t feel like I have lost my mind. I could not distinguish if it was metallic or anything…in was just a dark dark grey almost like a void of color. Not shiny at all. The actual object…

summary: Me and my Wknow 100% for sure that these weren't any kind of weather balloons , Orbs , Star link , rockets , comets or asteroid!!!!!!!!
description:
At approximately 2:45 I went outside to take my dog out and looking up to the sky and saw 2 bright lights heading Westbound from East Mesa. At first I wasn't sure what it was, it was fairly large and had bright pink/fuchsia lighting on the bottom. I alerted my wife and she saw it too, we rushed inside and got out telescope and binoculars and went back out. The lights were moving fast one passing another or staying still and from from west to east. We located them through the binoculars and I saw an unidentified object - it was slight oval shaped the material was very light almost transparent /silverish. And 6 very distinct round lights on the bottom. My wife looked and also confirmed the color of the lights and the material appearance. We watched as they went through the sky elevating at times, nearly disappeared and reappeared, or the light would dim and get brighter until they were no longer visible.

summary: Explanation:  Aircraft - Possible
description:
We saw an aircraft moving from north to south and there were two red dots flying at the same speed ahead of the aircraft.
We saw what we thought was a light colored aircraft which was flying from North to South toward our location. Ahead of the aircraft were two red dots ahead flying at the same speed. Then one of the red dots moved back to the side of the aircraft like it was checking it out. Then both dots changed positions several times with one moving behind the aircraft, then moving back in front. There were several cirrus clouds to the south and they all flew above the first one and we lost sight of all three. Then the aircraft flew out of the cirrus and we did not see the red dots again. Since they were flying from North to South they passed almost over location.
NUFORC Note:
Possibilities:
1. Military or law enforcement escort/intercept (Most likely) -
Two smaller aircraft (possibly fighters) maneuvering around a larger plane for training or identification. The position changes (front, side, rear) match standard intercept procedures.
2. Formation flight training -
Three aircraft flying together, with two repositioning relative to the lead aircraft as part of normal…

summary: They caught my eye as they looked like stars moving, most went for west to east, but also saw some north to south.
description: They looked like stars moving, they kept coming for about 20-25 minutes, most went west to east, but many went faster then other and crossed paths. Some went north to south, they were bright white and some where a very light green. Was around 6AM when I saw the first one, after a bit I went in to get my phone and then took some videos which were time stamped 6:22 through 6:25AM MST. The moon started to come up from behind the hill so sky it got lighter thus hard to see them. Caught video of some that crossed paths. Watched videos of Starlink flairs, which looked much like what I saw, but there paths were all straight, ones I saw were not all straight in fact about half changed direction in mid flight, like some made 90' change. I have also seen the Skylinks, in the past which where all straight in a line (lined up) and they appeared to be closer and moved faster. summary: Giant blue orb that shot down like a meteor towards the mountain
description:
A very large greenish blue orb shot down like a shooting star towards the mountain. The orb itself was very large, nearly the size of the moon from my perspective, which means it was probably a very large object closer to the ground.
NUFORC Note:
There were numerous reports of a bright fireball (a very large meteor) over Utah, Wyoming, and Colorado on the evening of Thursday, February 5, 2026.
Thime aligns with reports submitted to the American Meteor Society (AMS), which logged dozens of sightings between 9:00 PM and 9:45 PM MST.
Experts believe the meteor traveled over the Rockies and likely flamed out (or potentially landed) near the Flaming Gorge area in southwest Wyoming. The blue-green color usually indicates the presence of magnesium or nickel in the meteor's composition as it vaporizes upon entry into Earth's atmosphere.

They stayed in this cycle as I drove 21 miles from the Gothenburg, NE exit to the Maxwell, NE exit, where I pulled off the interstate to record. I noticed they didn't seem to get any larger as I traveled towards them. Once I was parked, I exited the car and started to record. I caught two lights, then all dark, then four more lights illuminated randomly after 30 seconds or so. After recording, I went home to grab an actual camera, but the lights were gone by then. summary: Several bright light (like very bright stars) moving around in variable directions
description:
Several bright light initially thought to be very bright stars but happed to move in variable directions. The lights were fluctuating from very bright for few seconds to dimmed dark and bright again. They were variable in size and intensity (possibly distance). They were moving in all direction taking gentle turns and fast climbs. We were cruising at 40000 feets. Those lights were definitively much higher than us. This was reported to the italian traffic control, an aircrafts have also confirmed seeing the lights and the control informed us that this is not the first time that they get such report. This lasted for approximately 40 minutes. After 30 mins only one light was visible and moving. Approximately 350 nautical miles were covered without getting any closer. Pictures and video were taken.

summary: Saw three bright lights from a distance forming a V shape. As we approached it looked like a hovering V shaped craft. Silent then moved
description: We were driving down Route 9 towards Poughkeepsie when we saw these three bright white/yellowish lights in the distance over the trees. Looked about the size of an airplane, we assumed it was one approaching in our direction. As we got closer it looked stationary, and we stopped in traffic near the exit to the Poughkeepsie bridge and it was directly to our left, over the trees, in the direction of the Hudson river. Looking to our left we could see it was in fact stationary, hovering silently. The wingspan made it look about the size of an airplane, but the lights were V shaped at the front. The three lights we saw in the distance now were several lights forming this V shape, some blinking, some not. My wife was driving and she insists it looked more like a square. As we were stuck in traffic observing it it hovered there for about 15-20 seconds and then it suddenly started moving forward and slowly picking up speed, still completely silent. Once it was behind us I could see a small red light behind it, which might be part of why my wife thought it was more of a square. We didn't get to watch it fully disappear because we couldn't hold up the traffic and had to continue driving in…

summary: Sighting of sphere hovering in sky then slowly moving then zipped away
description: The sphere appeared to be slowly moving at first and a very bright light that encompassed the entire object. As it slowly moved towards the west the sun slowly stoped reflecting from it making it clear that it was a metallic sphere. Best described as a perfect circle of light at first, but too bright for the time of day and how big it was. Then in a flash it zipped to the left and dashed south disappearing in a blink of an eye.

summary: Spinning Cigar UAP accompanied by Orbs
description:
I was outside during a perfectly clear daytime with deep blue skies when I noticed an unusual object in the sky. It was metallic and cigar-shaped (elongated, smooth, and cylindrical, similar to classic “cigar” or tic-tac descriptions I’ve seen in other reports). The surface appeared shiny and reflective, catching the sunlight distinctly.
The object was spinning or rotating a full 360 degrees clockwise as it moved. It rose steadily upward in a vertical (or near-vertical) trajectory, continuing to ascend smoothly and silently until it became too small or distant to see and completely disappeared from view. There was no visible sound, no exhaust trail, no wings, lights, or conventional propulsion features. The entire observation lasted about 10min.
Immediately after noticing it, I tried to film and photograph the object multiple times with my smartphone camera, including several longer recordings where I kept the phone pointed at the sky in the area where the object was visible to my naked eye. To my surprise, the cigar-shaped object did not appear at all on the camera—neither in the live viewfinder/preview nor in any of the recorded videos. It was completely absent/invisible on the…

summary: A short, inconsistent velocity along a single trajectory
description:
Seen between the Hydra and Monoceros constellations moving in the direction of Jupiter. It was only a brief glimpse but it appeared to accelerate quickly and then slow down. And before it came to a stop, it disappeared entirely.
It looked like an exact replica of Jupiter in terms of color, size and brightness but it traveled across the sky like a satellite. I would have thought it was one but it decelerated before the light disappeared.

summary: Multiple crafts flying up and down, disappearing for a few hours each night
description: There are many visible, illuminating crafts flying up and down over the ocean at various altitudes. They appear and disappear. Sometimes, there’s one, sometimes a few of them at once, either going the same direction or different directions. At first it seemed like satellites until I noticed the activity happening in one location with great frequency. Satellite tracking doesn’t coincide with this ufo activity in any way. My country is known for lots of ufo activity. I am a private pilot and i have studied ufos for many years, so from my experience, my expert opinion is that they are 100% ufo activities. Sighting of this activity happens very often by others, with sightings of crafts coming over land and going close to the ground. I know I will see them again tonight. But again, I repeat, my country has SIGNIFICANT ufo activity, especially as of lately.

summary: Driving along we saw it, as we went behind trees it ascended rapidly. Watched it move unnaturally
description: My daughter and I were driving and noticed a silver shaped ball in the sky. My daughter asked if that was a star and I told her that it was way too bright outside for us to be able to see any stars. It was around 5:10 PM in Missouri on February 4, 2026. We watched it for a few seconds and as we drove past a small patch of trees, may have been about 3 to 4 seconds, and looked, and it was gone. We were scouring the skies looking for it and could not find it. Just a few moments later, my daughter looked up into the sky and saw it at a much higher altitude. She watched it for several more seconds, maybe 10 seconds, before it disappeared from her sight. It was very strange how it jumped to a much higher altitude within just a few seconds.

summary: Triangular shaped, with cut corners. Saw while driving down highway. Low altitude
description: I was driving down the highway heading west on route 101 heading home from work. It was around 5:45 and the sun was almost set. I saw lights in the sky of what I first believed to be a large airplane while driving. As I continued driving down the highway I kept a watchful eye on the aircraft out of curiosity to make out what type of plane it was. A little more driving and it became clear it was an a low flying craft. It was dusk so the lights were what I was seeing from afar and initially basing my sighting off of. As a helicopter pilot, my intrigue grew even more for the aircraft which I now assumed to be a helicopter. As I drew closer to its location it didn't seem to move in the sky, but rather kept over a fixed location. I was driving at the time of the sighting, so if it was moving around in the sky it wasn't apparent or it was doing so at a slow pace. The closer I got to the craft the more confused I got, the lighting was spaced too far apart and not in the orientation to be that of a helicopter. When I became abeam it on the highway I looked up at it for a final view before passing, it was clearly a triangle(appeared to be a parallel triangle) slightly larger than the size…

summary: Two black horseshoe crab shaped objects heading the reverse direction of the Seatac arrivals flight path.
description:
I was grabbing something out of my car just now, and sadly did not have my cellphone on me to capture video.
I witnessed two black horseshoe crab (sans tails) shaped objects moving at a faster pace than the planes, in a line, holding the same altitude the whole time they were in view. They seemed to be > 1000 yards apart, and were heading the opposite direction of the arrivals flight path at Seatac (I live on 1st Ave and 119th ST SW, see planes landing at Seatac, constantly, and they are always arriving from the north, heading south.
These two craft were moving south to north, in what would have intersected the flight path at some point due to how low they were. They both went by about 15 seconds after a commercial jet was landing. At first I thought they were very large balloons of some sort, but they only moved horizontally as I saw them, and were never ascending like a balloon, or the way anything else without propulsion might ascend as it moved in the wind currents.
There is also not a lot of wind to credit their speed to, and the part that has me very confused is that they both kept angling upwards 90º, with their tip at the back of the object pointing downwards, briefly,…

summary: Two black horseshoe crab shaped objects heading the reverse direction of the Seatac arrivals flight path.
description:
I was grabbing something out of my car just now, and sadly did not have my cellphone on me to capture video.
I witnessed two black horseshoe crab (sans tails) shaped objects moving at a faster pace than the planes, in a line, holding the same altitude the whole time they were in view. They seemed to be > 1000 yards apart, and were heading the opposite direction of the arrivals flight path at Seatac (I live on 1st Ave and 119th ST SW, see planes landing at Seatac, constantly, and they are always arriving from the north, heading south.
These two craft were moving south to north, in what would have intersected the flight path at some point due to how low they were. They both went by about 15 seconds after a commercial jet was landing. At first I thought they were very large balloons of some sort, but they only moved horizontally as I saw them, and were never ascending like a balloon, or the way anything else without propulsion might ascend as it moved in the wind currents.
There is also not a lot of wind to credit their speed to, and the part that has me very confused is that they both kept angling upwards 90º, with their tip at the back of the object pointing downwards, briefly,…

summary: Very fast bright amber light moving north. Faded out a pulsed back many times before disappearing after holding a steady brightness.
description: Saw a single very bright amber light straight overhead traveling north moving very fast. I thought it was a shooting star at first but then realized it was not. It never burned out the way a shooting star does. It traveled north until out of sight over the foothills. Compared to a jet liner it was easily moving four times as fast. I'd say better than 2,000 miles an hour. Before it disappeared over the foothills, it faded out but then pulsed back to full brightness. It did this multiple times before finally going out of view behind the foothills. I've seen the ISS many times. This was moving far faster through the night sky. I just randomly stepped outside and there it was. Weather was clear and calm with a lot of extra light from a very bright moon. After seeing this I had goosebumps for a good fifteen minutes. Definitely not a satellite or ISS or any kind of plane or helicopter. I can't even begin to guess what it could have been.

summary: Sighting from Airplane
description:
Flight 990 from LGA to MCO was descending to land and pilot suddenly accelerated and pulled right and away from the airport. We drove south of MCO down to St Cloud. I was facing the window and looked out and saw two bright lights that were stationary and beaming. They were defying normal flight patterns and moving around each other. I recorded them and observed for over 3 minutes before we redirected our landing. Our pilot said we changed course due to winds but I didn’t notice any change of winds or interference in feeling. A plane flew directly by the lights and it was evident I was not mistaken in my judgement of their abnormality.
I have been observing aerial phenomena for nearly 20 years and felt something in the sky before I saw it.

summary: Floating triangular craft with white lights hovered over Wishram Heights turned toward us then vanished
description: It wasn't moving, just floating, white lights on, not flashing. We were traveling East from the west of Dallesport, Wa. Noticed planes flying to Portland, Oregon from the East. One particular craft we noticed was floating above the houses in Wishram Heights, WA. It was triangular shape with white lights on the front of the craft, no other lights were noticeable. We pull aside of the road to see what was unbelievable, noticed while parking it turned toward our direction. Looked out the window again it was gone.

description:

On January 31, 2026, at approximately 8:30 PM, I was on my way to a karaoke outing with a friend when I observed and recorded a video of an object in the sky. The object closely resembled the one described in my earlier reports in terms of appearance and behavior.
Because this object has been observed on multiple occasions on different dates and during unrelated activities, I am submitting this report to document what appears to be repeated sightings of a similar unidentified aerial phenomenon. The consistency across these observations suggests a pattern worth formally recording.
This report is submitted to ensure the timeline of events is accurate and complete.

summary: I was traveling east to cross through Donner Pass Ca at 170 mph at 9,500 ft when I saw the object ahead and to my left.
description: I was flying east at 9,500 ft closing on Donner Pass to fly over Lake Tahoe to Minden Nv. Saw a stainless steel looking object like a bunt cake pan with a slight pointed tip on top. I passed it at very close range before I could react. 200 ft to my left and slightly above me. I was traveling at 170 mph. Not sure of the size as there was no reference objects to compare it too. Sighting lasted about 3 seconds before we passed. Call KTRK tower and reported it as a drone but there were no means of propulsion viewable.

summary: Red orb taking off straight up. If the trip was broken into 3rds the second third had a tail of flame off it after flame faded out slow
description: Sitting in my car on lunch I looked over towards walmart and saw a pretty large red orb moving (up or towards me southbound it was unknown at first) I watched it for 30-60 seconds the entire time visible to my eye. If its visible trip was broken into thirds this is what each third consisted of. First third was just a large orb moving quickly in an unknown direction but appeared to be straight up. The second third of its trip it had a flaming tail 3-4 times the length of the orb(hitting the atmosphere I assume, I have seen a rocket launch as a child and the flames were similar) the final third was after the flames died out it was back to just a large red orb that VERY swiftly for its size, shrunk to a pinpoint then nothing. I am a simple guy, I was not drunk or anything and someone was with me who saw at least some of this.

summary: Vertical object transforms to orb
description:
Around 0130 Jan 29 2026 -25c with wind chill I woke from falling a sleep in my sons bed watching a movie with him. Got up moved to our bedroom..I decided to look out our bedroom window second floor west facing direct to see if my wifes wild pet rabbits ate the carrorts she left out ... I noticed the moon was full and very bright. So naturally I always look at the stars. North of the moon was a bright white star with several stars off in the distance . Behind the tree limbs I noticed odd flashing lights to the west ..I lights caught my eyes only beacaue
I was asking myself who is flying a drone in this weather at this hour ...the light strobes white blue green then green white blue the fade in and out ..this object or UAP was more Vertical at first but hovering and moving up and down very slow but not dropping massive distances. I watched asking myself what or who are you ...as I watched the lights started to go blue and purple into a strobe like style but now its changing formation. I KNEW RIGHT AWAY I NEED TO GET MY PHONE. I took some pictures standard and zoom and fill zoom as I watched this happing I said in my head who are you ..this object then turned circular and went bright…

summary: I observed unidentified aerial objects over coastal waters with unusual movement while U.S. Navy aircraft were actively circling
description:
While looking out over the ocean, I observed two to three lights that seemed to be flashing and flitting about in a cluster, then disappearing, then showing up again. They were roughly at same aircraft altitude as planes coming in to LAX (5,000 ft?). Initially I assumed they were conventional aircraft in the distance, but one light suddenly moved a significant distance from left to right (east to west, parallel to the shore) in less than a second and stopped abruptly, with no visible trail or sound. I couldn’t believe what I was seeing but I saw exactly that. The movement was rapid and hummingbird-like. I immediately checked Flight Radar for flights in the area. FR showed that at the same time this happened, a U.S. Navy P-8 Poseidon aircraft was circling offshore in repeated patterns for over an hour. They were still up there, two hours after I saw the lights. Weather conditions were clear, some light cloudy haze, and the lights were visible only as points of light with no discernible structure.

summary: I saw a transparent, pulsating but non-blinking orb flying in a level line from North coming Southeast.
description: As I was driving home on Highway 41 going North, I was just coming up on the last curve before River Falls Rd when I saw a very bright, transparent non-blinking white light flying at an elevation of 500ft from North to Southeast. It flew in a straight line and I pulled over and began to film the object on my camera through my windshield. I attempted to zoom in a few times and them zoom out for scale. The moon was very bright outside and I noticed that the object seemed to be pulsating with light but not blinking. At one point, an airplane flew in the background in the East. The object was almost the same brightness as the stars in the background almost like a disguise. My sunroof was open and the object made no sound as it passed. Only the sounds of the road could be heard. After a while I lost sight of the object and stopped filming after I had stepped out of my car. It never veered from its path but seemed to pause at one point very briefly for half a second.

summary: Two silver balls moving like energy rather than craft, moving intellectually is all I can describe, like a intelligent plasma
description:
Two silver plasma like ufos (silver balls not a craft shape but a ball shape that didn’t seem solid all the time as it moved to organically ) were travelling towards tesco penzance, when one stoped and started scouting about the local houses and then up towards a coppice of trees where it then moved totally different to before ..it almost crawled down the biggest tree came out again in front of smaller trees and then went back into the coppice . I waited to see if any vehicles turned up to look because it was so out of this world, yet no one came and after half a hour i went to bed .
The experience felt peaceful it didn’t feel scary !

summary: I was driving through greenwood it went straight up in the sky from near me

I could tell when it left it wasn’t a wall it was a triangle. It was too fast to make sense of it. And I was listening to music so I couldn’t hear what it sounded like. I saw it for maybe 2 seconds and it was gone. I couldn’t see it because of my cars roof.

summary: Seen on security camera on a nightly basis for weeks
description:
Started noticing them last year. Appeared on security camera on a nightly basis around 1:30am. Lasted for weeks. If they remained longer than that, I do not know. I searched a few times but never seen them other than on my cameras and porch. Chalked it down to drones...
About 2-3 weeks ago, my cameras are picking them up again. They appear on camera about the same time every night. Usually between 3:30 and 4:00am. Can be seen between up to when the sun starts coming up. Same flight patterns, same type of light, Dim and then bright flashing. Fast and semi erratic movements. Again, first thought drone of some type. Last night, I seen them on camera, and went out into the freezing cold to look for them. Drove vehicle and spotted the flashes and movement and realized they were further away than what I thought. I drove 4 miles east and parked with lights off. They were still further east but maintaining the same general area. They appeared to me to be close to the Michaux State Forest. There were 4 that I seen in close proximity, but never were they all bright together. They would alternate. They appeared to be about 1,000 ft up, maybe even as high as 2500 feet altitude. Hard to say…

summary: Front edge bright white. Rest of the outline faint pink-orange forming disk. Body transparent.
description: Upon first sight, it appeared out of nowhere as a light in the shape of a boomerang, moving northeast (possibly over or near the Delaware river). Then it passed from behind a tree, at which point it seemed to enlarge, as if moving in my direction. Now, a complete outline became visible in the shape of a disk. It paused, then disappeared. There was no sound, it did not streak away, it vanished.

summary: Object came from the
description:
On Tuesday, January 27, 2026, at approximately 6:30 PM PST, I observed a very bright white object in the sky while driving southbound on Mission Trail in Lake Elsinore, CA, near the turn toward the dairy.
The object was located to the west/southwest, above the mountain line, and appeared to originate high in the sky (not from the ground or horizon). It initially looked like a very bright shooting star or meteor—significantly more intense than typical—but with a persistent, glowing white tail that remained visible throughout.
It descended at an angle (roughly 30–45 degrees initially), then changed direction multiple times over the course of the sighting. At one point, it appeared to move toward my location (approaching from the west), then receded away, and briefly exhibited circular or arcing motion (like a loop or tight curve). The entire event lasted approximately 30 seconds from first appearance to disappearance.
The light was pure bright white, steady (no pulsing, flickering, or color changes), with no blinking navigation lights or visible aircraft characteristics. There was no audible sound at all. The tail was trail-like and consistent, similar to a meteor but longer-lasting…

summary: I noticed a unique exhuast trail. Thought it military but not high enough in sky.
description: Exhaust trail really caught my eye. It exited from tail as thick and full then narrowed to something like donuts on a string?! The vehicle itself was pointed in a triangle or chevron shape. I did not see any detail on craft. I watched it for a few minutes. I was looking south and it was travelling west to east. I turned around to go inside to retrieve binoculars. I looked back, it was still in view. I turned away again then decided not to get binoculars. Turned back and it was gone. I continued looking for sevetal more minutes but never reappeared. I'm sure others must have seen it.

summary: Domed shaped objects interspersed with red lights parked in open desert
description: I know the roads out here well- I always camp in the deserts out here in my vehicle. I was looking for a place to sleep for the night on a jeep trail off of hwy 93 30 miles north of Las Vegas in a remote area. As I was driving down the jeep trail I came upon two domes that had bright red lights on them. One dome looked bigger than the other one. I had my brights on and I didn’t see any light reflections coming off a parked car out there. Now I regret not approaching those domes(I was about 2000 feet from them or less) and taking video. I just didn’t want to be rude because I thought they were just campers who erected large tents sleeping in there for the night.…

summary: Bright light appeared, shot up into sky, scattered into smaller pieces
description: So I was listening to ebaG outside the bagel deli when this red light appeared on the road behind me, it was so bright I couldn't look at it directly but it was like this small sphere kinda thing. I felt really afraid when I saw it, and the only thing really keeping me from running was the sound of ebaG in my headphones keeping me grounded to reality. After resisting this weird sensation for a couple minutes, the light started floating slowly at first, but then rapidly shooting up into the sky and exploding, almost like a firework, except the particles it scattered didn't dissipate but instead shot off in all directions. I was incredibly shaken up by this experience so I ran home immediately to tell my roommate, ebaG, about this incident.

summary: Stable pulsing lights that began to move fast overhead, completely silent
description: Driving home from Lake City a flat line of multiple green and yellow glowing lights caught my eye as I came to off State Road 27 onto Highway 47. Moving around the glowing object there was a large strobing of red light with no discernible pattern, almost like a small red tinted lighting storm. As I pulled into my driveway I noticed the object had moved and was now flying directly above the tree canopy on at the perimeter of my property. It was incredibly low, with multiple lights casting off in different directions. At first I thought it was a helicopter or very low flying plane, however, it made no noise and moved very fast. Very peculiar.

summary: Huge yellow glowing sphere about 100 square meters in size rises into the sky
description:
I was in a field and saw a huge yellow glowing sphere about 100 square meters in size rise into the sky. I didn't have my phone available, but from my position, I had a good view of the sky. I retrieved my phone and tried to film; it was moving quickly up and down, from left to right, very fast, before disappearing behind a purple stripe.
Original report in Italian:
Mi trovavo in un campo ho visto un enorme sfera luminosa gialla dalle grandi dimensioni circa 100 mt quadrati sollevarsi in cielo non avevo il cellulare a disposizione ma dalla mia posizione avevo una buona vista sul cielo ho recuperato il cellulare e ho provato a filmare si spostava velocemente in alto e in basso da sinistra a destra molto velocemente per poi andare via dietro una striscia viola

duration: My father and I always wa
summary: In the summer especially, when my father would take my brother and me to school, they were there.
description:
When I was younger, my father would take me early to catch the school bus. In the summer, some days we could see these UFOs; they would stop in the air, stay for a while, and then start moving. At first, very slowly, but soon they would accelerate, sometimes change direction, and then begin to rise at an absurd speed and quickly disappear. Sometimes more than one would appear; we have seen blue, green, white, and purple ones.
Original report in Portuguese:
Quando mais nova, meu pai me levava cedo para ir pegar o transporte escolar. No verão alguns dias podiamos ver esses OVNIs, eles paravam no ar, ficavam por um tempo e começavam a se mover. No começo, bem lentamente, mas logo aceleravam, mudavam de direção as vezes e entao começavam a subir em uma velocidade absurda e logo sumiam. As vezes apareciam mais de um, já vimos azuis, verdes, brancos e roxos.

Quando mais nova, meu pai me levava cedo para ir pegar o transporte escolar. No verão alguns dias podiamos ver esses OVNIs, eles paravam no ar, ficavam por um tempo e começavam a se mover. No começo, bem lentamente, mas logo aceleravam, mudavam de direção as vezes e entao começavam a subir em uma velocidade absurda e logo sumiam. As vezes apareciam mais de um, já vimos azuis, verdes, brancos e roxos.

summary: Strange aircraft on the highway
description:
At around 10:00pm in this general area; there was a thick fog covering the highway. It was unusual because the fog was forming low on the ground but wouldn’t dip below a certain elevation. I was told that the pin drop I provided is a natural depression. So all the heavier gasses from the oilfield collects around that area. And I’m not sure for certain if this was the reason why the fog wouldn’t dip below a certain elevation. The fog was extremely thick, and the border where the fog started and ended was extremely distinct. It kind of looked like how water oil looks when they’ve settled apart. I was admiring the unusual weather pattern when I noticed on my right was an aircraft that looked something like a hybrid between a chrysalis, and a dragon fly. This thing did not have wings and the lights on it were bright and multicolored. It was flying south, then changed orientation but not direction. At this moment there were at least 2 other cars driving north who would have seen the same thing I did. Eventually it flew SE and disappeared from my view.

summary: We saw a red orb fly over the ocean to land being escorted by a helicopter
description:
On January 25, 2026, I was standing on my patio facing the ocean and saw a helicopter hovering above the ocean. It seemed odd for the time of day but assumed it was a Coast Guard situation.
After approximately five minutes, I brought this to the attention of my two friends. Just at that moment, the helicopter and orb started flying toward land. It was approximately 100 yards away from us and maybe 50 to another hundred yards high.
We could only hear the one helicopter, but it was just behind a red orb.
Just as it got over land, maybe 400 yards or so, the red orb just shot off into the sky and the helicopter couldn’t keep up and flew south.
Just about an hour later, the helicopter came flying back the opposite direction towards the ocean. No Orb in site but the helicopter flew over the ocean and I followed it with my binoculars until I couldn’t see it over the horizon anymore.
The next day, my neighbor asked if I had seen something weird the night before. To which I said, “ you mean that helicopter following that weird light?” she replied, “YES”. Her son also saw the red orb shoot off and the helicopter fly away.

summary: Swarm of dozens of UAP, similar looking to satellites but changes in direction
description:
On 24 January 2026, 0047hrs ACDT, I stepped outside in Adelaide, noticed five point-like lights in the sky (looked like satellites) close together, moving with the same trajectory, but then deviating. I pointed my compass, 3016 mils (south), altitude 286 metres and saw Three heading east, two southwest. All silent.
Over the next hour, at least 40 more appeared, I had lost count, drifting predominately in an E, or ENE direction. Ninety percent steady blue, ten percent white. Three of the whites flared bright as the ISS, held for five seconds each, then dimmed. One, after its flare, slid south, then did a clean S-turn, then proceeded east and vanished.
A half-second white blip flashed in that same slice of sky right after. No red or green strobes. No engine noise. No moon. Sky was black, no clouds.
I started recording—only caught my watch and the compass. Footage's useless for detail, but the time and bearing are on screen. I filmed sober, military, no visual problems. Some might've been Starlink and legitimate satellites, etc but 50%+ weren't following any train or normal satelite trajectory.

summary: Swarm of dozens of UAP, similar looking to satellites but changes in direction
description:
On 24 January 2026, 0047hrs ACDT, I stepped outside in Adelaide, noticed five point-like lights in the sky (looked like satellites) close together, moving with the same trajectory, but then deviating. I pointed my compass, 3016 mils (south), altitude 286 metres and saw Three heading east, two southwest. All silent.
Over the next hour, at least 40 more appeared, I had lost count, drifting predominately in an E, or ENE direction. Ninety percent steady blue, ten percent white. Three of the whites flared bright as the ISS, held for five seconds each, then dimmed. One, after its flare, slid south, then did a clean S-turn, then proceeded east and vanished.
A half-second white blip flashed in that same slice of sky right after. No red or green strobes. No engine noise. No moon. Sky was black, no clouds.
I started recording—only caught my watch and the compass. Footage's useless for detail, but the time and bearing are on screen. I filmed sober, military, no visual problems. Some might've been Starlink and legitimate satellites, etc but 50%+ weren't following any train or normal satelite trajectory.

summary: Had red and blue lights that went in a circle
description:
I was driving home from work when I saw this semi circle disk that had lights that were red and blue that went in a circular pattern. It was traveling pretty slow and by the tree line.
I was watching it for about 5 minutes when it disappeared. When I was past the the fairgrounds about 3 minutes later it reappeared and still moving slowly.
It was heading west when I noticed it vanished from view.
From what I could see it was disk shaped.

summary: Formation of 4 large glowing orbs in a stationary horizontal arc. Observed for several miles on the right side of I-5 North (Eastward).
description:
Observation and Environment
On the night of January 22, 2026, while driving North on the I-5 freeway toward the outskirts of Los Angeles, I observed a series of unusual lights. The sighting occurred as I was traveling past several buildings in the Newhall Pass area. I maintained visual contact with the object for a significant portion of the drive.
Object Description
The object consisted of four large, bright balls of light arranged in a distinct horizontal curve or arc. It did not appear as four separate craft, but rather as one massive, structured unit. The lights were solid and did not pulse or flicker. Despite the distance, the object appeared much higher in the sky than standard commercial drones or helicopters.
Movement and Behavior
The most notable characteristic was that the object remained perfectly stationary in its relative position in the sky. Despite traveling at freeway speeds, the object did not move across my field of vision; it stayed "locked" in the same spot, similar to how the moon appears while driving. The object was located on the right side of the vehicle (Eastward) toward the mountain ridges.
Conclusion of Sighting
The object was obscured multiple times as…

summary: Explanation:  Chinese Lantern - Possible
description:
Orange fireball like UAP in the sky
As we were driving on I-280 North crossing the I-280 Skyway Bridge approaching the Detroit and 75 split by the Jeep Plant a bright orange fireball looking light appeared. My fiancé and I both noticed it seconds within each other, it was visible to us for about 45 to 60 seconds before it disappeared fast! It did not have any blinking lights like a satellite or airplane, it was stationary, bright almost like a star. Distinctive from a helicopter or drone. We are very familiar with how those look and this was definitely not either of those nor any type of aircraft.
After disappearing it did not leave a trail of any kind.

We are very familiar with how those look and this was definitely not either of those nor any type of aircraft.
After disappearing it did not leave a trail of any kind.

summary: Explanation:  Starlink (Racetrack) - Possible
description:
5-7 white lights varying in brightness flying in triangular formations at high altitudes and high rates of speed.
My co-pilot and I were flying from the NYC area to Miami, Florida at 43,000 feet. First observed around 8:30pm eastern time over Savannah, Georgia and last observed around 9:15pm when we were over Orlando, Florida. We observed 5-7 white lights flying in triangular formations at very high rates of speed and very high altitudes. The location of the lights seemed to be just over the Gulf of Mexico (very hard to tell exactly where they were). The lights were flying in triangular formations rapidly changing directions and altitudes (they were kind of flying in a corkscrew pattern and they all stayed in the same rough location). The lights would vary in brightness (as bright as the ISS and almost as bright as the moon at times but focused in small single points) and would start off as very dim lights, get exponentially brighter then fade away to nothing as they changed directions and altitudes. These lights were way way way above us, and we were cruising at 43,000 feet which is higher than about 90% of all aviation traffic. These lights were definitely not satellites or star…

summary: Two objects moving parallel suddenly turned 90 degrees and moved in opposite directions.
description: We were at Flinders Golf Club cliff top road Victoria Australia waiting for the Aurora Australis on the 20th of January 2026. It was approximately 10.00pm. We were teaching our three year old to spot satellites. Looking South East we saw two objects that looked like satellites moving parallel to each other ( not one behind the other as in Starlink). They looked like regular satellites until they suddenly simultaneously turned 90 degrees and moved in opposite directions. They were travelling South to North, then one turned East and one turned West. We saw them for another few seconds before they disappeared. The sky was fairly clear that night and we could see the Milky Way pretty well. The moon was not in view.

description:

Everyone who saw it said it was something black moving super fast like it was a plane, but it was too black and round to look like a plane. It kind of moved super fast and came back after we passed by; it seemed scary because it was daytime, the sky was clear, and there were no planes or helicopters nearby.

summary: Noticed the ball of light, orange with red in one spot in the sky,so move but disappeared twice and reappeared, the beam not visible
description:
We were on a rooftop; four of us in total, when we noticed a bright object in the sky. It appeared as a glowing orange sphere with red swirling light inside and remained stationary, not moving from its position. Over approximately 15 minutes, the object completely disappeared twice and then reappeared in the same spot. One image shows a black blur triangle like shape but it was not visible after that one image nor by the naked eye.
One photo captured what appears to be a vertical beam of light extending straight upward into the sky. This beam was not visible to the naked eye and was only noticed when reviewing the images afterward.
Initially, we considered that it might be a drone, but it did not display blinking lights, showed no movement, appeared too high in altitude, and the red swirling light within the object did not align with typical drone characteristics. The object ultimately hovered in the same spot and then disappeared after the beam photo was taken.

It hovered right in the area right above the Millard Airport and the lights became very bright like a football field at night. It was very large and dramatic looking. I first noticed it above the Target Store in K Plaza. It was moving slowly in a big arc to the northwest and came full circle a bit to the south of where I first saw it. It hovered right in the area right above the Millard Airport and the lights became very bright like a football field at night. I thought it must be a drone, so I went into Target and shopped for about 30 minutes. When I came out, it was still hovering in the area of the airport. It started moving north again, back towards the stores where I was shopping and made the long arcing circle again. It went back to the airport area and hovered again. I went into Walmart, which is just a couple blocks west and I went in to shop. When I came out the aircraft was still in the area circling slowly. I tried to follow it and headed west on L St. and took a photo. I was able to keep up with it for a short time. It was silver-gray, had kind of a faceted body and it was wide. It was longer than a commercial passenger jet. It had 3 lights. One…

summary: White cylinder shape orb
description: Walking my dog in back yard looking at stars and noticed this object which changed direction at the very end it makes a right turn, before that it slows down, in some of the close ups looks like cigar shaped. I know what satellite look like as I see them nightly, and planes as this is a major route, no noise, no lights other than the white orb look. Maybe it’s the military with new technology, or copied technology.

summary: 3 lights in and out, changing altitude
description:
Almost every clear night between the hours of 3:15a-4:30a we see these lights above the horizon on the woolwich side of the bridge. We have confirmed they are not registered drones, they do not blink and are not any other colors. They don’t more irrationally, but rather slowly and will fade in and out of being bright to not visible. Most of the time they are in a large triangle formation, always 3 of them. This has been an occurrence happening off and on around the exact same time for at least a year.

summary: Purple orb - moving very quickly
description: My son and I went out to see if we could see the aurora borealis tonight as we heard it would be visible after dark. After a few moments a purple orb appeared, NE of our home and nothing else was visible in the sky. It moved very quickly around the sky, would dissapear then come back and was pulsating. It was definitely not a plane or a rocket and made no sound.

I was not alone, the other pilot also saw the same thing.

Saw some bright white lights moving very fast up and down left and right until the light turned completely dark and then it lit up again and did the same thing multiple times at very high altitude. We were cruising at 40,000 ft and these lights were way above, impossible to be an aircraft.
I was not alone, the other pilot also saw the same thing.

summary: Orb with small light in the center shout out a light and it turn into a right cloud
description: I was drive back home at night around 720pm or so and I looked up and noticed like a star that had what looked like an invisible shield like a round orb surrounding the bright light. I slowed down cause I thought it was odd and my kids saw it too after they saw me staring for a while. We noticed it was moving from our right going left. The I pull down my window to look at it better and my daughter who was sitting in the passenger side was watching with me when we saw a light flash out straight stopped like it hit something and created a ring and the ring melted getting bigger. I told my daughter to record but both our phone sucked. Then the orb start moving again and we couldn't see it more. I live in the country so you can really see the night sky and stars and I've never seen some things like that. Only in movies

summary: Large white orb hovering over house, flew through smoke ring then moved south and became 2
description: I was backing down my driveway with my car facing my house. Suddenly I see a very large white light appear above the house. Key detail, there were no clouds in the sky, and the weather has continued to be clear for the rest of the night. The light was pointing towards me when all of a sudden a smoke ring blew out of the left view of the light. So the light was facing east but blew a smoke ring to the south and hovered. The ring had to have come from it or something flying with it because it started as a puff and grew to be much larger in diameter than the light. Everything in the vicinity around the light then became hazy in nature and as the smoke dissipated the light slowly flew through the remaining ring. The light also should have been pointing in the direction it was flying, but it did not look like it ever turned and stayed shining at me the entire time even as it moved to my left. It then paused just slightly past the edge of the house for several seconds long enough for me to start recording it. I also called my parents who came outside and witnessed the rest of the encounter. It was much larger in nature than any other plane or starlight in the sky. There was no sound at…

summary: Twin lights maintaining perfect distance before blinking out.
description: Saw what I initially believed to be a plane from behind clouds (despite it being a clear night) but no engine noise. Thought it might be ISS due to the time of day but noticed a fainter whiter light leading the larger brighter light. The two were roughly 40-60 degrees above the horizon and traveling due east (from southwest of my position to due south) maintaining perfect distance before blinking out (presumably upon entering earth’s shadow). Impossible to tell if one craft or two in formation.

summary: It was a smoke ball covering a rectangular shape made from 2 separate pieces.
description: Me and my dad were driving Westbound on Interstate 10 just west of Sealy Texas, it was night time and the sky was completely cloud free, we saw a glowing smoke ball above and in front of us, it blew a smoke ring in front of it that was visible from a mile away, we drove towards it until it was moving over us about 5000 feet off the ground. It was a ball of smoke about the size of a small plane with a object inside of it.

summary: UFO Light Orb Crossed the Sky
description: The light was growing brighter, and then blew clouds away. Kind of like when you blow smoke away from you. It blew in the direction it was flying (southeast). I was facing directly west, it was in front of me. Like five miles in the sky? and from my perspective was going left (southeast). After it blew the clouds away, it went through the hole pocket, kept going, was dimming in and out. I tried following it but it just disappeared. It didn’t have any flashing lights, that’s how I’m certain it wasn’t man made aircraft. And it was HIGH in the sky. I live next to a hospital with a landing pad, and the helicopters and airplanes I see nearby don’t fly that high.

summary: 1 orb turned into 2
description: My husband and i were driving north on 144 towards granbury from glenrose when he looked out of his window and saw a bright light at first we just thought it was a plane until a smoke ring appeared from it and thats when we pulled over and i started taking video then the one orb split into 2 orbs and disappeared

description: Saw what looked like the moon behind clouds tonight and looked at it (stationary) for a while, and then took out my moon app (Moonlitt) to confirm it was the moon and learned the moon was way lower in the sky (behind a house), and then suddenly this same light started moving very rapidly (much quicker than a plane would go) through the sky… No idea what it is, but my son (who was with me) said, “It’s a spaceship, Dad!” There appears to be 2 separate objects—the light and then something to the left of it that almost has the shape of a flying saucer.

summary: UFO Light Orb Crossed the Sky
description: The light was growing brighter, and then blew clouds away. Kind of like when you blow smoke away from you. It blew in the direction it was flying (southeast). I was facing directly west, it was in front of me. Like five miles in the sky? and from my perspective was going left (southeast). After it blew the clouds away, it went through the hole pocket, kept going, was dimming in and out. I tried following it but it just disappeared. It didn’t have any flashing lights, that’s how I’m certain it wasn’t man made aircraft. And it was HIGH in the sky. I live next to a hospital with a landing pad, and the helicopters and airplanes I see nearby don’t fly that high.

summary: Large white, non-blinking light that seemed to burst out a conical vapor trail in front of it.
description:
I was walking my dog with my kids in my neighborhood. We saw a large white light moving fast (faster than a plane) and much closer to the ground. The light was not blinking and there were no red safety lights either. It was completely silent. It moved parallel to the ground appearing just above the tree line in my neighborhood. It then appeared to eject a fast moving conical vapor cloud in front of it that slowly dissipated. It looked like it was traveling west to east and then turned towards the south and disappeared. I live somewhat close to Shawnee Municipal Airport and can tell what a plane or helicopter looks like and this was not a helicopter or plane. I also considered that it was the rotating safety ground light from the airport, but it did not look anything like that either.

description: It was a cloudy night, and my partner and I were driving on the highway. You could not see a single star when a very bright white light started poking through the clouds. It was a tiny circle and was not moving, which is why I assumed it was just the moon slightly showing. Then suddenly a smoke ring appeared around travelling in front of the light. As the smoke ring was fading the light moved in the direction the smoke had went and then disappeared.
