summary: Hazy moonlike object starts pulsing blue and emits water vapor(?) rings from its front
description:
I was nearly home from walking our dog when I noticed something strange in the sky. The moon appeared to hang over our house, except that it was too small and it should not be in that position at this time in the evening. I scanned the rest of the sky for the moon and could not locate it so I started to believe that the object in front of me might somehow actually be the moon.
I immediately knew that it wasn’t the moon when it started traveling from the west to the southeast.
After a while, this cloudy object started kind of pulsing blue, emitting some kind of aura. It then began pumping large rings from its front at about five second intervals.
I panicked trying to decide whether I should firstcall my wife outside or film the event. The object was moving so slowly that I decided to call her and get her outside. By the time I got off the phone and started recording the object, it was a pretty distant blur in the sky. She did get to witness the last minute of it speeding off.
One of the interesting things is that this object was bright enough to be picked up by the sensors in an iPhone, even as it flew off over the horizon. We live in a neighborhood and light pollution normally…

summary: Bright light, “smoke ring”, acceleration, second object appears, “chase”, first object disappears second object illuminates and vanish
description:
A bright, blurry object was moving from north to south across the western sky. At first, I thought it was an airplane—it appeared out of focus and moving slowly. I even wondered if it was a cloud, but there were no clouds at all and the stars were clearly visible.
As it continued, the light grew brighter, almost as if it turned toward me. Suddenly, there was a large flash, followed by what I can only describe as a smoke ring. The object then rapidly accelerated south.
Shortly after the smoke ring appeared, a second object emerged in front of the first, appearing to chase it across the sky. As they moved nearly due south, the first object vanished. Moments later, the second object emitted a bright flash of light and then disappeared as well.

I scanned the rest of the sky for the moon and could not locate it so I started to believe that the object in front of me might somehow actually be the moon.
I immediately knew that it wasn’t the moon when it started traveling from the west to the southeast.
After a while, this cloudy object started kind of pulsing blue, emitting some kind of aura. It then began pumping large rings from its front at about five second intervals.
I panicked trying to decide whether I should firstcall my wife outside or film the event. The object was moving so slowly that I decided to call her and get her outside. By the time I got off the phone and started recording the object, it was a pretty distant blur in the sky. She did get to witness the last minute of it speeding off.
One of the interesting things is that this object was bright enough to be picked up by the sensors in an iPhone, even as it flew off over the horizon. We live in a neighborhood and light pollution normally…

summary: Bright light, “smoke ring”, acceleration, second object appears, “chase”, first object disappears second object illuminates and vanish
description:
A bright, blurry object was moving from north to south across the western sky. At first, I thought it was an airplane—it appeared out of focus and moving slowly. I even wondered if it was a cloud, but there were no clouds at all and the stars were clearly visible.
As it continued, the light grew brighter, almost as if it turned toward me. Suddenly, there was a large flash, followed by what I can only describe as a smoke ring. The object then rapidly accelerated south.
Shortly after the smoke ring appeared, a second object emerged in front of the first, appearing to chase it across the sky. As they moved nearly due south, the first object vanished. Moments later, the second object emitted a bright flash of light and then disappeared as well.

As the smoke ring was fading the light moved in the direction the smoke had went and then disappeared.

summary: A ball of light seen moving across the sky with a forward projection of a pulse or beam of circular light.
description: I was on a walk with my family yesterday evening, on the 19th of January, when a light was first noticed coming from the northwest. My children pointed it out to me, and we began to watch it together. It remained visible long enough that I decided to take out my phone and start recording. What stood out most was its persistence and the appearance of what looked like clouds or mist around it, along with the absence of flashing red or blue lights typically seen on an aircraft. The light stayed steady as we followed it overhead, and toward the middle to end of the video, it projected a circular beam of light forward before continuing over the horizon in a southeastern direction. It was witnessed by myself, my wife and our five children.

summary: Sat in the sky surrounded by a cloud? Or Mist of some sort for around 2 minutes than slowly moved
description: While working my railroad taxi job I was heading south west from La junta CO to Trinidad CO when I noticed a bright light that closely resembled the moon behind a cloud but much much smaller. confused as to what I was looking at I watched it for approximately 2-3 minutes before I noticed it was slowly moving across the sky. Seeing this I pulled my phone out and recorded it continuing to move at a slow pace until it suddenly “blew” I suppose is the best word for it, a ring shaped cloud in front of it and slowly dimmed until it disappeared among the stars.

summary: Moving at a steady speed not changing altitude. Produced smoke ring. Light was constant. Unable to see shape of object only light seen.
description: I was located just east of the airport when I saw the light moving west to east. Airplanes do not travel that way or fly over the city. No blinking or colored lights visible, solid bright white light only. Did not change speed, shape or altitude. Seemed to produce a smoke ring that moved downwards towards the city. Flight was too high for a helicopter and too low for a plane.

summary: Saw a light in the Western sky that moved to the South, then seemed to burst out a semi-circle of similar colored light before fading.
description:
Heading West on I-80, my girlfriend and myself saw a light ahead roughly fifteen degrees above the horizon, which we wondered if it were a star or something else because it was very bright. It was just under some clouds, and we wondered if it could be the tip of a crescent moon peaking out because of the yellow-orange warm light color. It was a bit blurry presumably because there were light clouds making things a bit hazy. It went behind the cloud for a minute or two, then we noticed it again further to the South, and for about two minutes watched it move to roughly due South, then it seemed to burst in light, and a semi-circle, like part of a halo, formed over a few seconds on the Eastern side of the light and radiated out from the light, growing and fading for about a minute or two until it disapeared, the light began to fade as well and faded from view a half-minute or so later.
NUFORC Note:
Possibly the time was misreported and this is the rocket that was seen widely that night as the decription matches.

description:
Heading West on I-80, my girlfriend and myself saw a light ahead roughly fifteen degrees above the horizon, which we wondered if it were a star or something else because it was very bright. It was just under some clouds, and we wondered if it could be the tip of a crescent moon peaking out because of the yellow-orange warm light color. It was a bit blurry presumably because there were light clouds making things a bit hazy. It went behind the cloud for a minute or two, then we noticed it again further to the South, and for about two minutes watched it move to roughly due South, then it seemed to burst in light, and a semi-circle, like part of a halo, formed over a few seconds on the Eastern side of the light and radiated out from the light, growing and fading for about a minute or two until it disapeared, the light began to fade as well and faded from view a half-minute or so later.
NUFORC Note:
Possibly the time was misreported and this is the rocket that was seen widely that night as the decription matches.

summary: A bright white light coming from the west that emitted some sort of pulse that looked like a horizontal smoke ring.
description: My wife and I were on our property putting the horse and goats to bed when I noticed a bright white light over the house, it was moving unusually fast coming east from the west. It was unusually bright compared to any other aircraft in the area. My wife reminded me to take a video so I started recording. After recording for a minute or so I turned it off so I could take a picture. While I was playing with the photo settings the object emitted some kind of pulse out of the side which looked like a smoke ring that was aimed toward the north, though the object seemed to be heading south west. In the second video you can still see a bit of the ring shape.

summary: Explanation:  Balloon - Probable
description:
Pick ace shaped, very bright. The “tail” was opaque. It was streaking across the sky. East to west
Delevan Wildlife Refuge - Blind 24
Time of sighting approx. 2:30 p.m.
Weather: was foggy all am til 1pm. At the time of sighting, it was sunny, with calm winds, and high cirrus clouds at 55 degrees.
I was duck hunting, scanning the sky. I noticed movement. Towards the south, high in the sky. It was moving rapidly (aircraft speed). From east to west.
Something odd-shaped, like a jellyfish, horseshoe crab, pick axe or kite.
It had a head and a tail. The head was semicircular, crescent moon-style, and looked somewhat flat. And very bright. I couldn’t tell what color the object was. It was very bright, shiny, reflective or like looking at an LED bulb. And would vary in intensity in brilliance. Seemingly when the sun hits it a certain way.
From the center of the head was a “tail” that followed straight back. About 3x the length of the head. It had a club end, a bit darker than the tail, which was opaque (like an X-ray image) and had even lines throughout its length like how a spine is segmented.
The tail looked like it would sway. Not excessively or fast. It just kind of moved. It was…

summary: All I saw were lights in a circle land in neighbors yard
description:
I think I was abducted. I saw white lights in a circle around the craft but the craft itself could not be seen, just the lights.
After it registered I ran to my car and locked the doors with my dog and hid in the passenger side curled up in a ball hiding my eyes deep in the arm of my jacket.
I was frozen in fear as I heard clicking and footsteps outside on the porch. My dog growled at something and that’s when I knew it was real. Then I was thinking that the car was locked. At that point I heard something knocking on the glass of the car. I dare not look. My dog stood over me as he growled louder.
My thoughts were jarbled. Then came a headache and red flashing behind my eyes almost like a red nebula. I was scared. The last thought I had was I hope they don’t realize the trunk is unlocked. My dog is growling louder and low as I hear the trunk open and something crawling on the plastic in the back, my dog is standing over me but no other noise came from him like he was hypnotized and then I felt light and foggy. This is the last thing I remember as I wake up an hour or two later in a state of shock. Oddly, with the freezing temperatures my body was warm, my feet and hands not numb…

summary: Multiple cloud obscured lights, varying size, color and shape.
description: I was looking for stars or orbs, as I’ve documented sightings at this location in the past. It was around 9:20pm when I looked up and noticed a crescent shaped light in the clouds. At first i thought it was the moon, but realized it wasn’t out that night. Then additional lights started appearing in a sort of line, but they were each different shapes, colors, orientation in the sky, varying levels of brightness, and they all seemed to phase in brightness around the same time, but not exactly. I kept waiting for break in the clouds, but when they approached, the light would fade, I could never make out a craft, or light source. Based on their placement, inconsistency shape, etc, I find it incredibly hard to believe they were ground to sky projections. I also posted my video I captured on TikTok where someone commented that they also saw the event while driving “back from Michigan”. So I can’t verify where they were, what they saw, but they said they pulled over and have pictures of the event from that night. They did not move, they remained static, and were only visible for a few minutes. I have video of the event I can provide.

summary: First noticed a super bright low flying orange light that turned into two forward facing wing lights.
description: On above date and approx. time I was outside with my dog in our back yard and noticed a large brilliant orange approaching through the tree's directly toward our house.I ran inside and woke my wife to come see.By the time we got back outside it was two lights on some sort of aircraft that flew over head at approx 1000 ft. or less. As it passed over i could see the lights on what appeared to be some type of aircraft about the size of a corporate jet with the light glow obscuring clear definition making a very faint jet engine sound, there was also a small blinking white light under the center.It was heading NW to SE. Also the lights appeared to be on wing tips.

While hovering in place, you can see both objects oscillating back and forth. After a few min, one of the objects lights dimmed out and disappeared. The second object disappeared minutes later while hovering in place.

While hovering in place, you can see both objects oscillating back and forth. After a few min, one of the objects lights dimmed out and disappeared. The second object disappeared minutes later while hovering in place.

summary: I saw it while driving my car to work
description:
I was driving to work. As I was coming into Lucan (Ireland) at roughly 18:10. I noticed that what looked like an extremely bright star. It really caught my eye. I was driving away while observing it for a good 5-10 minutes. At one stage it looked like cross in the sky. As I passed it, I could see it was a craft with pulsating lights.
I was considering pulling over on the motorway to get a picture/video but I was going to work & I was weary about pulling over on a busy motorway. I couldn't really judge movement that well because I was travelling in a car. It was moving.
I work right behind Dublin airport & Baldonnel Airport corps base is only a 15 minute drive away. I served in the Irish Naval service. Part of my role was spotting aircrafts, trawlers & other ships. I haven't a clue what I saw tonight. It wasn't a plane, helicopter or standard drone that I know of. The brightness of it coming up the M6 motorway was phenomenal. It was like a beacon in the sky. It was something a person could easily dismiss as a star from a distance.

summary: Silver sphere close to camp Bowie guard base
description: Two jets making a lot of noise drew my attention to the sky as I was watching what appeared to be the jets dog fighting a metallic sphere came into view moving north to south in a straight line at a high rate of speed making no noise that I could hear over the noise of the jets it was only in view for maybe 3 seconds due to its speed and very hard to see with the blue sky behind it.

summary: Geometric Circle with Multi Colored lights
description:
I went to to my mail box to retrieve my mail. As customary habit I like to look at the sky. My mail box is 75-100 feet from my house on the road. While walking to get the mail, about half to the road, I looked up in the sky due east, I saw to bright objects, planets I though. One I believe might have been Venus. The other, was more orange and larger. As I got to my mail of of the box I look at into the sky again. The orange ball was closer and moving. First reaction was a plane. But I did not normal lights (white, red, green). From recollection there was two orange circle one smaller than the other and moving towards my location. I stopped to listen for engine noise, nothing but silence. We have a lot of airport around so I know the sound of landing jets.
I picked up my mail and started to had back in the the house, looking up expecting an orange ball I saw a perfect geometric circle with lights The object looked translucent. The was a brighter light in the center and a large amount of lights in a geometric pattern. The lights appear to be connect by some sort of support. The lights were average brightness. They would fade in brilliance and change to another color. The colors was…

summary: Decide to lie on my chair and look at the beautiful sky as the sun was setting and stars came out whilst on vinted on my phone
description: The 2 small orb like lights came out out of nowhere. I saw one at a time,The first came from the west and went north then went east and went back north behind a cloud.The second came from the south and went straight north in the same direction. At first thought was a plane like most people would,But no engine noise no flashing lights not outline of wings or anything not even a trail.Pure silence the orbs sometimes glowed as if u was changing the brightness on you’re phone. second one appeared to like like it world shake and move slowly to avoid objects and couldn’t keep a straight line.The best way to describe it was like a firefly moving.The lights were also extremely high up to also be a plane and obviously they were just two small ish orbs that obviously wouldn’t be a plane either due to the circular shape. I also have 3 videos and a photo as I rushed to get my phone. I got one video and photo on the first and 2 videos on the second.Another thing that I found strange after the incident stopped and I couldn’t see them anymore.My Depop account that I was on trying to sell clothes kept crashing and wouldn’t work and my whole phone froze.Despite being connected to the internet…

location: Itanhandu, State of Minas Gerais, Brazil
summary: UFO on the Mantiqueira mountain range.
description:
I have lived in the mountains since I was little, true countryside. One night, I went out to close the corral because the dogs were agitated, barking at the hill. The sky was clear when I saw a large, bluish-white light appearing behind the mountain. It didn't blink, it made no noise at all.
The light simply stopped in the air. It stayed there for a few minutes, with other smaller lights swirling around it. The air became heavy, my phone turned off by itself, and the dogs hid. Then, it moved sideways without tilting and ascended at an impossible speed, disappearing into the sky.
The next day, the grass near the corral was flattened in a circle. I know what I saw. That was neither an airplane nor a star.
Original report in Portuguese:
Moro na serra desde pequeno, interior de verdade. Numa noite, saí pra fechar o curral porque os cachorros estavam agitados, latindo pro morro. O céu tava limpo quando vi uma luz grande, branca azulada, surgindo por trás da montanha. Não piscava, não fazia barulho nenhum.
A luz simplesmente parou no ar. Ficou ali alguns minutos, com outras luzes menores girando em volta. O ar ficou pesado, meu celular apagou sozinho e os cachorros se esconderam.…

summary: Explanation:  Balloon - Possible
description:
While stopped at a light, saw a round, metallic-looking, highly reflective object in the sky to the east.
The object was slightly above eye level, to the east. It was highly reflective. I thought at first it was Venus, but it was too late in the morning and Venus doesn't look to be a metallic silver color. It was stationary and very bright. No moving lights. I looked away for a second and when I looked back, it was gone. There were no other objects in the sky at the time. Saw a plane a few seconds later, but in a different location, heading north, a lot lower in the sky. It wasn't nearly as reflective.

summary: High altitude and directional change.
description:
Appeared at high altitude and would descend behind coast range in a corkscrew or J-hook manuever. East of viewing location. Distance hard to judge. Estimated over Roseburg, Or. 4 or 5 yellow lights at a time. Change of direction as descending occasionally ascending. Occasionally multiple would converge and descend together. Continued viewing until 0530. Also observed following day same time. Checked NOTAMS for any reported military activity. None found. Real time flight tracker showed no aircraft with active transponders. No sound heard.

summary: Well, saw a ufo and had a uap experience today - FUCKING awesome, very cool, highly recommend it.
description:
So a little about me, I have lived in this city all my life. As best as I can recall this is the first profound experience I have had involving UAP or the phenomenon, although I've had a strange thing here or there once or twice in the past (such as one time I saw a ghost of my dog in my house). I've also had an extremely sharp increase in occurances of unexplained phenonmenon in my life in recent months and it's really tested my grip on reality as most anyone I try and relate these things to is like "oh yeah sure hetzjagd *followed by some other sarcastic remark*. Oh yeah and it's also worth mentioning I've been a believer about as long as I can remember. Probably the earliest memory I have of being introduced to and believing in the phenonmenon would be watching Unsolved Mysteries on Saturday nights in the early 90's. I also know at least one other person who has a story to tell although they basically have recently stated they do not wish for me to talk about them or their experience or anything else related to them so I have to abide by that for now.
I was driving in my car and it happened around 4:00pm-ish I would estimate. I know this because I made a phone call soon after…

summary: Something black with lights, but it stayed for about 30 seconds or so and then rose again
description:
It was 1:58 in the morning and I went to close the window because it was a bit cold and the sky was clear. Now it is 3:06 in the morning and when I looked at the sky I saw only stars and some clouds when I spotted something black shining with yellowish lights moving back and forth as if someone was controlling it but very high up to the point of seeing very little, just enough to make it out. It looked like a star but was moving in a strange way until it descended a bit and I saw something black with lights, but it stayed for about 30 seconds or so and then rose again, and when I looked again it had disappeared. It lasted about 7 minutes or less. I closed the window and didn't look anymore, and this will stay in my mind forever because only I know what I saw. Many will disbelieve, but what I'm saying is true, and it left me very scared because I don't know what it is or what that was.
Original report in Portuguese:
Era 1:58 da manhã e eu fui fechar a janela pois estava um pouco frio e o céu estava limpo agora são 03:06 da manhã e quando olhei pro céu vi só estrelas e algumas nuvens quando avistei um negócio preto brilhando com luzes meias amareladas andando pra um lado e pro outro…

description: I saw 1 larger brighter craft flying south and a smaller 1 flying south. I thought they were satellites until they stopped in the sky near each other. After a few moments they resumed their flight. The smaller southbound one stopped again and released a 3rd craft that followed the northbound craft out of sight. The southbound one began flying again and turned sharply east and flew out of sight. Shortly after, a small craft came out of the north then turned sharply east and followed the craft that had released the smaller one making me think it could be the 3rd craft returning to the 2nd or possibly a 4th craft.

The southbound one began flying again and turned sharply east and flew out of sight. Shortly after, a small craft came out of the north then turned sharply east and followed the craft that had released the smaller one making me think it could be the 3rd craft returning to the 2nd or possibly a 4th craft.

summary: Unusual flashing and strobe like lights
description:
At approx 1:10 am I saw a flashing white light emerge from the star Arcturus. I was watching it intensely when I saw it “glitch” out and appear and disappear rapidly in its flight path. That was when I used my binoculars to track it and see if I can see any visible details on the aircraft. What I saw was several red lights swarm around the main aircraft; they were also blinking . The main aircraft had a blinking white light (I assume it was the headlights, but on the underside of the aircraft I saw red strobe lights move around in a circular motion. The mini lights that were swarming the main craft could not be seen from the human eye and if it wasn’t for the binoculars I wouldn’t have seen them swarm the main craft. The craft was moving east to north but as it approached north I lost sight of it from the light pollution. I remained outside for several minutes to see if any other activity surfaced. This isn’t the first time I’ve seen a UFO at this location.

summary: I saw a dark shadow move across the sky and a disappearing "star" roughly in the direction it traveled in.
description: While outside smoking a cigarette I was looking at the sky as I usually do, I look down at my cigarette and my eyes notice what I thought was a shadow moving rapidly from north to south. It was roughly 20-25 degrees off of the horizon and as large as my thumb if I were to extend my arm fully. I had enough time to look up at it and catch it and then it was just gone. I first thought that it could be a nocturnal bird as we have some out here in central Ohio. It was when I looked in the direction it seemed to be going I noticed what I thought was Jupiter in the sky, except as soon as I looked at it, it started to dim eventually into nothing. The dimming was a few seconds long. There was just the faintest cloud cover, almost like a haze tonight so I thought it had just disappeared behind a cloud, but upon looking around I could see many dim stars and Jupiter was where it was supposed to be and easily visible in a different part of the sky. It was 100% not the clouds as they were not thick enough to even blot out most stars and I could see Orion clearly. This light, whatever it was, was brighter than any star and certainly brighter than Jupiter. The light never returned. All of this…

summary: Saw two very bright "stars", one above the other. But i know my night sky and noticed instantly these were out of place.
description:
I was running a Northern Lights tour at Þingvellir, something I’ve done for over a decade, so I’m very familiar with the night sky and with the kinds of phenomena you normally see out there.
When we arrived at our final location, sometime around 9:50–10:00 pm, we stepped out of the car and almost immediately noticed a very bright fireball shooting across the sky. I’ve seen fireballs many times during tours, but this one stood out. It left a trail as expected, but unlike most fireballs I’ve seen, it didn’t break up, burst, or visibly end. Instead, it traveled from south to north for roughly 6–8 seconds and continued all the way until it disappeared behind the horizon. It also stayed the same color the entire time, which felt unusual compared to the color changes I normally see as fireballs pass through the atmosphere.
Later on, while we were stargazing and I was about halfway through my program, I noticed two very bright, star-like objects to the north-northwest, roughly in the direction of Hvalfjörður. What immediately caught my attention was that those “stars” were not supposed to be there. They were clearly out of place.
At first, both objects remained completely stationary…

summary: Triangle UFO, three lights-green, white , red.
description: I walked out of my house for a quick Walmart trip. I always look up on clear nights because Orion is directly in front of the house. I saw a bright light, which were actually 2 when I took a second glance. It was kind of low and hardly moving. Before I got to my car, I noticed it was moving very slowly. I thought it was odd because I couldn’t hear anything. We hear planes leaving and return the marine base every day. When i left the driveway, I saw that it was slightly lower so I grabbed my phone. That’s when I noticed the third light and the formation. Clear as day they formed a triangle so I took out my phone and recorded it. It was surreal. The movement suggested that if it were a plane, it should have fallen to the ground. I followed it by car and watched it go to the north west. When I was returning home, I saw it again coming back south east. I called my wife and told her she needed to come out and see it. I picked her up, and we headed back to where I last saw it and that’s when it got stranger. There were 2 more but higher. They had no real flight path, BUT they seemed to do the exact same things, as in move to the south east, then the other would eventually move that…

summary: Yellow orb spawned 3 more orbs sequentially into a straight line of 4 equidistant orbs before disappearing and repeating the sequence
description: While driving south on 931, out of my windshield I saw a yellow light appear up in the sky, which quickly spawned a second light that shot out from it and traveled maybe a few hundred yards north before stopping, which then shot out a third light that did the same thing, which spawned a fourth light, resulting in a string of four evenly spaced yellow lights that stayed visible momentarily before fading away. This happened several times in a row, lasting a few seconds each time. Once I stopped at a traffic light, I opened the moon roof on my car to see if it would happen again, and sure enough, it did. The string of activity lasted about a minute or two at most.

summary: 5 or 6 bright white lights in a straight line
description:
Coming home from work and turned North on Springmill road off of Indiana 32 in Westfield Indiana. About 1/4 of a mile up the road at about 45 degrees above the horizon, probably a bit less, I see a straight line of very bright white lights. Within about 5 or 10 seconds the lights go out 1 by 1 from left to right in fairly quick succession. I keep watch on the sky the best I can while I’m driving and sure enough, about 20 seconds later they appear again, but farther north from where I first saw them. There is no way I can tell how far they traveled, but once again, after seeing them for about 10 seconds, they went out one by one from left to right. I was coming up on some trees and lost most of the horizon, but as I tuned east on 191st street I came into a clearing again and saw the lights in the distance which must have been 4 or 5 miles.
This was NOT Starlink. This was NOT an airplane. If this matters at 6:15 pm there is very little light in the sky. These could have been drones I suppose, but I haven’t really been around or seen many drones before. We had steady winds of about 11 mph.
The next morning when I went to work, I sought out a friend of mine who drives north and…

summary: 4 lights in a straight line turning off one at a time and then turning back on one at a time while moving northward.
description: I was driving west heading home to Tipton Indiana. In front of me to the west I see 4 bright lites turn on 1 at a time in a straight line all at the same altitude. It seemed as though they would have been attached to a single craft. The lights were perhaps a mile or less from me at approximately 2000 ft. The lites came on for only a few seconds , and then went off one at a time. Within 20 seconds the lights appeared again coming on 1 at a time, only the lights were farther north this time, and the lights turned on and then off the same as before. The same sequence happened again farther north again. I then saw them come on a fourth time even farther north though the were facing a different angle as if the object was changing direction from a northern heading to a heading of north west. It was not quite dark and you could still see the blue sky, and though the lights seemed that they would have been attached to a single object, you could not see an object. Only the bright white lights turning on one at a time until all four were illuminated before turning off one at a time until all four lights were off. Though I was alone in my truck I was in a line of traffic. I highly doubt I…

summary: I was on the balcony and looked at the beach when 5 points of bright light appeared, stationary and in a V formation.
description:
I was on the balcony of the apartment when it appeared, it didn't come from anywhere, it simply appeared as 5 points of bright light in a V formation. At first, I thought it was a drone, but 2 of the lights descended into the sea, another 2 went towards the fishermen's boat, only the first one stayed still, and when I was going to grab my phone, the 4 quickly gathered and each went to a different corner. But the first one ascended so fast that I've never seen anything like it in my life. Since then, I've been looking at the same time and place to see if I see it again.
Original report in Portuguese:
Está na varanda do apto quando surgiu, não veio de canto nenhum simples apareceu 5 pontos de luz clara em formação V. Primeiramente achei que era drone mais 2 das luzes desceu para dentro do mar, outras duas foram para o barco dos pescadores só a primeira fico parada e quando ia pegar o celular as 4 se reuniram rapidamente e cada um foi para um canto. Mais a primeira subiu tão rápido que nunca na minha vida vi uma coisa assim. E desapareceu desde então fico olhando na mesma hora e lugar para ver se eu vejo novamente

Cruzava o céu em uma velocidade baixa de mais para ser um meteoro.

summary: Horizontal line of yellow/white light orbs 5-6, blinking out and back on one at a time. Reappearing in new location.
description: My daughter and I were driving home from gymnastics practice. We were headed southbound on US 31. We were in fulton county just a couple miles from home. I caught some light directly above US 31 a little ahead of me. This was not my first time seeing them but it still took my brain a bit to catch up. Same as my first siting (april 2025 - never reported). A horizontal line of orb like lights (yellow/white) in color appeared - perfect alignment. They blinked out one by one from left to right - giving almost a merging effect. They reappeared in a new location (heading west) blinking on one orb at a time. I also noticed that once all the orbs were ‘off’ you could still see - not sure how to describe it - a shimmer? I would not have likely noticed it had I not just been looking at the orbs before they blinked out. No red or green lights indicating a drone. Best guess they were 40-60ft in the air? The first time I witnessed this same light behavior was in Fulton County, IN but a different location. I spotted them on Old US 31 as I was heading into town. They would have only been 30-40ft in the air and were above buildings in the downtown area. Same behavior, same alignment, shape,…

summary: While walking along the trail, I spotted the bright blue object near the water in the center of the lake.
description: As I walked along the trail, I noticed an intensely blue object hovering silently above the water, right in the center of the lake. The light pulsed irregularly, reflecting off the surface as if distorting the surrounding environment. There was no sound, just a strange sensation of electricity in the air. The object remained motionless for a few seconds and then accelerated vertically, disappearing into the sky in the blink of an eye.

summary: It was very scary; my friend and I thought we were going to die.
description: I was finishing dinner and took a nap. I woke up at 11:00 PM, took a shower, and lay down on the sofa. After a while, I saw a light in the sky; I thought it was just a star, I don't know. Then I woke my friend up to see it too. He went to look, and when I saw, it had changed color. It was white and kept changing color; first it was green, then yellow, then a very light blue, and it stayed those colors until then. My friend said that it was very strange. So we went inside, put on pants and a long shirt, grabbed two machetes, one for me and one for him, and we kind of started following it, but we were running because that thing in the sky was not normal; it was very fast. Then suddenly it started coming down. My friend and I stopped and went into the tall grass. When we looked, it was in front of us, very far away, like about 40 meters. We started getting closer, and we could no longer hear the sounds of frogs or the bees we raised there. There were a lot of dogs, and they were all acting strange and barking at night, but it became so quiet that we got scared, and we couldn't hear anything, just me and my friend walking in the tall grass. When we looked back at where the UFO was, we…

location: Cape Saint Francis, Eastern Cape, South Africa
summary: Two light objects started darting around the sky then disappeared together
description:
I was outside of my home about to shower outside. Then I looked up at the sky and a light in the sky started to move north-east from Cape St Francis toward Jefferys Bay bay.
The light was moving in one straight direction then started to dart around the sky in a very fast very erratic way. Like changing direction like a seismograph reading. The light was a white/yellow light with no other lights flashing. Just one colour. The movement was the thing that was irregular.
Then an additional light moved towards it from the outer bay towards the light. So moving from a north position towards a south-west. It was moving faster and in a straight trajectory. Then it started to dart around as well.
Then they both disappeared together towards the sea bay area.
Then they were gone.

location: Cape Saint Francis, Eastern Cape, South Africa
summary: Two light objects started darting around the sky then disappeared together
description:
I was outside of my home about to shower outside. Then I looked up at the sky and a light in the sky started to move north-east from Cape St Francis toward Jefferys Bay bay.
The light was moving in one straight direction then started to dart around the sky in a very fast very erratic way. Like changing direction like a seismograph reading. The light was a white/yellow light with no other lights flashing. Just one colour. The movement was the thing that was irregular.
Then an additional light moved towards it from the outer bay towards the light. So moving from a north position towards a south-west. It was moving faster and in a straight trajectory. Then it started to dart around as well.
Then they both disappeared together towards the sea bay area.
Then they were gone.

summary: 4-5 orbs of light seen and filmed moving and brightening in sky
description:
At 8:50ish I noticed some orbs of light on the horizon that appeared to move in a strange manner. I watched for a moment, and realized they were not blinking, and thus had no navigation lights. At that point I began to film in my iPhone. The orbs can be seen mainly in the right center of the screen. They move relatively slowly, but seem to increase in brightness, before going completely dark. I noticed them moving from below the horizon, straight up into the sky, as well as horizontally. I could only keep track of a specific orb until it went dark and then I could not see it anymore, this is why my count may be incorrect. I have watched satellites and planes from this second story window and they always had consistent flight paths and/or navigation lights. Not the most provocative story, but they were there for approximately a half hour, and I showed the video to family and friends and no one has a decent explanation, other than a private drone flight(s).
NUFORC Note:
Possibly satellite flares

summary: We saw a large sphere with different colored lights flashing.
description:
My girlfriend looked out the door and saw a light that didn't move and looked unusual. I got my binoculars and saw a round circle or ball of different colored lights. They were flashing reds and other colors. They flashed independently of each other, but constantly rapidlly flashing. They were in a perfect circle. Later, after we got home, it was still there, but did not appear to be a perfect circle. It looked like the right side (from my position) was missing. She said she saw other ones, but this is the only one I could really see. It was in the southeast sky. To the naked eye it looked like a star but a little too big.
NUFORC Note:
Likely Sirius, the brightest star in the night sky. In the winter and early spring, Sirius sits in the southeast.
It is famous for "sparkling" like a diamond and flashing vivid colors (especially red and blue) because it is so bright that the atmospheric interference is much more noticeable than with dimmer stars.

summary: I was in my parents' room watching TV until I looked at the sky and saw that.

Eu estava deitada no quarto dos meus pais vendo tv até que eu olhei para o céu pela janela e fiz um avistamento que se não me engano pela terceira vez só daquele tipo mas desenrolando era um círculo era pequeno e rodava dava voltas e andava para frente em velocidade surpreendente tinha uma colocação vermelha até que do nada a velocidade aumentou e aquilo sumiu

I was lying in my parents' room watching TV when I looked at the sky through the window and made a sighting that, if I'm not mistaken, was the third time of that kind, but unfolding, it was a circle, it was small and spinning, going around and moving forward at an astonishing speed, it had a red placement until suddenly the speed increased and it disappeared.
Original report in Portuguese:
Eu estava deitada no quarto dos meus pais vendo tv até que eu olhei para o céu pela janela e fiz um avistamento que se não me engano pela terceira vez só daquele tipo mas desenrolando era um círculo era pequeno e rodava dava voltas e andava para frente em velocidade surpreendente tinha uma colocação vermelha até que do nada a velocidade aumentou e aquilo sumiu
region: Sete Lagoas, State of Minas Gerais

summary: Possible half sphere, slow flying, not very high, bright, and without sound
description: My mom was walking the dog, she saw a half sphere, illuminated by a very bright light, she thought it was the moon, but it was slowly moving and was only a few hundred meters of the ground, it didnt emit sound,. it flew above our house and lit up a circle around it and it was very very bright, it shined a light in a direction and several weird light formations surrounded it. It then started moving again, after some time it became illuminated fog in the sky, slowly vanishing. My mom did not bring her phone so sadly we don't have any footage or pictures. i am watching the sky and nothing like this appeared.

summary: Very bright yellow lights ,appeared to be on a craft. Quite low but NO sound and appeared very large moving slowly.
description:
I was driving towards Downham mkt on the A1101 when I saw what was a very large craft with 4 or 5 large very bright yellow lights. I turned down Squires Drove and It was moving to my left which is approximately towards March direction. I opened my window & pulled over to see if I could hear it, It was silent. It was moving very slowly . I tried to find my phone to take a photo but sadly I missed my chance. I saw 2 red lights much smaller than the yellow ones and the yellow lights slowly disappeared along with the red lights and I have no idea where it went .
When I got to Downham mkt I mentioned nothing RE what I saw and my b. friend said 5 minutes before I got there the sky had lit up a very bright yellow. I would need to speak to him about it again to get more details ..

summary: Large amount of random intensity orbish / lights
description: There was a stream of orbish/lights shooting across the sky in varying intensity. Some would move slower, some faster, some would disappear on one view of the sky to appear on the other side popping out of nowhere but following the same trajectory. There were several instances where these objects would burst into a highly subdued but colorful sort of like an airburst of color. There was what appeared to be a disc that was really dim, highly subdued and looked like it split in half. All the objects were coming from whatever this was. i can't really explain what we were looking at..There were multiple times where these things would change direction, instantly, without like appearing to slow down. summary: I saw a strange cigar-shaped ship with bright, colorful lights. It vanished before my brother saw it. I’m still scared!
description:
When I was 8 years old, now I'm 14, I saw a spaceship that was strange, kind of shaped like a cigar. In front of it, there were round lights with many bright colors. But since I wanted someone to witness it, I called my younger brother, and when he looked, it was no longer there... This scares me a lot!

Quando eu tinha 8 anos tenho 14 vi uma nave espacial que era estranha tipo o formato de um charuto. Na frente dela tinha luzes redondas com muitas cores brilhantes redondas. Mas como queria ter alguém de testemunha chamei meu irmão mais novo e quando ele olhou não estava mais lá.,. Isso me assusta muito!

summary: Saw item stationary in night sky. Moved when plane nearby then back to same location. Saw 2 times.
description:
Saw small orange sphere in the sky as i was closing curtain for night. Got binoculars and saw triangular shape with orb at apex and layers of light below. Not plane or other aircraft. Noted that a flash of yellow, orange and red light cut across triangle from L to R about every 7-8 min. Also saw it move in sky slowly about 10 inches in sky when a plane came across sky. It returned to its location as plane passed by. This happened at least 2x as i observed it do same action w 2 different aircraft over a 25 min period.
Location is near/above oregon state university research center off Miley Road and also Aurora Airport.

Noted that a flash of yellow, orange and red light cut across triangle from L to R about every 7-8 min. Also saw it move in sky slowly about 10 inches in sky when a plane came across sky. It returned to its location as plane passed by. This happened at least 2x as i observed it do same action w 2 different aircraft over a 25 min period.
Location is near/above oregon state university research center off Miley Road and also Aurora Airport.

summary: Awoken by bright light - saw a bright orange orb
description:
At approximately 3:00 AM (not sure on exact time) on January 9, 2026, I was awakened by an extremely bright light coming through my bedroom window. The light was bright enough to wake me from sleep.
When I looked out the window, I saw what appeared to be an orange sphere in the sky. The object was stationary - it was not moving at all. The brightness was extraordinary - similar in intensity to looking at the sun.
Due to the darkness and lack of reference points, I could not determine the size of the object or its distance from my location.
The color was distinctly orange throughout. There was no sound associated with the object. I did not observe any movement, flashing, or change in the object’s appearance during my observation. After viewing it briefly, I returned to sleep.

summary: Lights in the sky originating from 1 to 3 and pulses of light.
description: Started with sighting a bright green light in the sky that faded and then had blue and purple pulses of light around it. After watching for a while 2 other lights appeared to be playing/circling the original light/orb with the same affects of pulsating light and colors. They would fade and then come back as a bright green/blue dot and then fade and start pulsing the blue/purple strobe, sometimes in a full circle and other times in a pulsing circle. Started around 1715 and ended around 2300.

summary: Star looking light moving unlike anything seen before in small space making erratic movements
description:
Imagine holding up a dime to sky at arms length creating an imaginary circle in which object stays inside. An unusually clear night with little light pollution.
Looking east finding Jupiter brightest object and then seeing unusual object about 4 oclock maybe ESE my location. My roommate was watching for half an hour and called me out to see this unusual thing. At first appeared like a star which pulsated slightly in light intensity. Suddenly it moved. Then it moved again up then down then diagonally then like a 'J' shape then a swiggle then stop and stable then again repeat and stop all within small space of that imagined dime circle space, never going outside that space. Sighting started for us about 7:30 PM January 8th and we observed about an hour, got cold and went inside and back outside a few times while object stayed the same until clouds occurred about 11:00 PM which blocked our view. Don't really know when this started or ended but I will be looking there next clear night. I do often look at sky and stars from my house 24 years now in an area with moderate to light pollution especially looking east. Never saw anything like this before. Exactly what this was, I leave to…

summary: Craft following American Eagle flight RPA4712
description: Hello, I am a US Army combat infantry veteran that is trained as a sniper and in intelligence gathering currently living in Knoxville, Tennessee. As I was taking my dogs out after dinner, I heard an aircraft overhead as was usual as I live close to McGhee Tyson Airport(TYS). But as I watched the plane fly overhead, I noticed something behind it, a UAP that from what I could tell, was at the same altitude and was matching the speed of the aircraft. The UAP looked to be roughly following at around 100ft-200ft behind the aircraft as it traveled NE at around 35,000ft. I could not make out the shape of the UAP, but I noticed the lights as white, steady, and in a somewhat triangular shape. The known aircraft lights however, were standard anti-collision like, pulsing from white and red on the wingtips. The aircraft continued NE with the UAP trailing behind it until it disappeared into the clouds and out of view. After returning into my house, I opened my flight radar application on my phone to see what aircraft were flying overhead at the time I was outside. The only craft I saw was an Embraer E175LR operated by American Airlines, flight RPA4712. There were no other radar contacts…

summary: 6 lights in a line, not breaking formation, seen for 1 1/2 hours from North Berwick to Topsham, always through passenger side window
description:
My husband and I noticed six lights, the front two rectangular and the flanks rhombozidal. It stayed in view during our hour and half drive from North Berwick to Tophsam, always in the upper left quadrant of the passenger side window unless we made a curve. All the way on 95 from North Berwick to Topsham. If it was a formation, they stayed so tight as to appear they did not move relative to each other. Jupiter was out, but these were six lights. In Freeport, it was low enough that I could see it through the trees. Yes, it is possible they were round lights, but I watched the damn thing for an hour and a half and I am telling you they were rectangular.
It did not appear to move. That's the weirdest part. We watched an object, driving at 70 mph, for an hour and a half and I'm telling you, I watched through my passenger window.
NUFORC Note:
No such pattern of stars were in that portion of the sky at that time.

summary: Circular UFO with orange color and Lights seen high in the sky
description: My wife and I were driving I-90 East and coming around a bend in the highway we both saw a circular structure high in sky that looked lit by orange lights. Appeared stationary. It was dark out and sky was cloudy. When I first saw it I was thinking it looked like a structure or building on a tall mountain and then it dawned that the Berkshires were not that tall. What made me think mountain was that the structure appeared to be standing still. No flashing lights or blinking - just a hazy orange. my wife and I looked at each other and said “Are you seeing that?” We kept driving as there were other cars on the road (not many) and there wasn’t a really good spot to pull off (did not want to cause an accident). Once we realized what we were seeing was not explainable I told my wife to grab her phone and take a picture or video. Eventually she had the phone but by that time we had passed too far and it vanished in the clouds or had disappeared. We talked about taking an exit and going back in the opposite direction but by the time we got to a them NY exit we thought it would be difficult to find the exact spot we were at. We spent the rest of the trip home discussing what we saw and…

summary: “Eye in the Sky” spotted in Portland, OR
description:
After the Sun had set, dark outside but not nighttime yet. I noticed unusual warm light coming in the windows, like the golden hour in summer. I saw the biggest, brightest & lowest “star” I’ve ever seen - with spikey light shooting off all around it, mostly warm white at this point. I watched it move directly downward, then quickly to the right, then return to the left. I grabbed my camera-phone at that point. It twinkled and roiled for a minute, getting bigger and brighter, changing constantly. For roughly 30sec it looked like Lady Guadalupe made of light. After a couple minutes it started gradually shrinking, and turned into a very small color changing ball. Then exited left in a straight line.
When I inverted the colors on my photos (negatives), it looked like an eyeball with shifting images in the pupil. Moving and blinking.

summary: Bowler Hat Shaped UAP
description:
About 2 hrs after I had made another UAP report this same night a tiny (about the size of a small comercial drone) object was flying through the night sky at very low altitude. This object looked like a bowler hat or like the Taco Bell symbol. It was all green with some white lights next to it. This object made no noise, and didn’t emit any kind radiation that I’m aware of. Something strange did happen as soon as It got close to where I was. A pack of coyotes (maybe 4 or 5) began signaling to each other for about 15 to 30 mins straight. I don’t know if they were signaling each other to be regrouped, it was almost as if they were sending out a distress signal to everyone in the area. As the object was leaving my view there was an important but very small detail that I noticed about the bottom of this aircraft. The lights that lit the underside of the craft remained leveled to the ground below, but eventually it began to tilt; about 30 degrees facing west. summary: UAP Drone goes dark
description: This flying aircraft was making an unusual maneuver so as I was shadowing it. Suddenly it started changing light signals mid flight, and returned back to the direction it came from. Once it stopped moving the lights changed again to its original red blinking light sequence. And then suddenly in mid air, it went dark. In the moonlight I saw what I believe was that Aircraft make a rapid boomerang maneuver.

summary: Multiple lights fading in and out flying in various directions in the same part of the sky
description:
On January 5th 2026 at around 8pm I noticed out my livivng room window what I thought to be a helicopter traveling just above the tree line to the west then seemed to disappear. I assumed it had went behind a cloud. However then I saw the same thing moments later (although going in a slightly different path/direction).
I decided to step outside to see if there were helicopters or planes searching the area or something. I noticed there were no clouds in the sky and as I was looking in the direction of where I had seen the light, 2 more lights faded in to sight (the lights never flashed or appeared or disappeared instantly, always fading in and out). I watched their path as they both appeared to travel from west to east (towards me but never closer, appeared to only travel short distances in the same part of the sky). As they would fade out 1 or 2 more would fade in sometimes shortly after the others disappeared and sometime more than a few minutes later.
I grabbed my phone and binoculars to take video and get a closer look. Through the binoculars all I could see were balls of light (the objects were too far away to see any detail). The video I took only shows moving lights in the…

summary: I was walking through my property, and I looked up and saw this glowing orb in the sky not very high. It was made of lightning.
description: I was walking through my property, checking some traps and things because we’ve had a coyote problem with our cattle. Well, when I looked up to look at the stars like I sometimes do, I saw this medium sized (probably 4 or 5 feet in diameter) sphere. It was a ball of lightning, it hurt to look at. I know it was real because I still have a spot in my vision from it.

summary: I watched a large craft shift from plane-like to glowing orb, then vanish
description: I was leaving a local grocer about reno and air depot. The skyline is pretty open atop the business and powerlines. I clocked a visible, relatively large "aircraft" and im always actively seeking ufos so i always make sure, is it a plane, or what else might it be. I kept manuvering in traffic keeping an eye through my rear view on this object i turn around into a nearby church to get a frontal view and end up infront of some trees but had kept the object in sight. I moved towards a visible skyline and by this time the very large steel and glass(because it did reflect light and what my brain processed.) Had transcended into a star like orb and further away into nothing, a manuever ive witnessed with a group before. Again I actively seek ufos and usually keep quiet on a handful of occassions but seeing how noticeable this craft I had to share. It was pretty big and most anyone who was aware of it most likely clocked it as a plane and went on but i always double check and today, I saw a ufo above mwc it was big and pretty close to home.

summary: A sphere slowly descended and landed at an angle, resting motionless with strange shapes visible, though observed from a distance.
description:
I was walking my girlfriends dog and noticed it hitting the ground from a height of a couple feet when I rounded the corner.
I rounded the corner of the apartment complex and saw it slowly land from the height of a couple feet. I do not know how high it came from before I showed up. The sphere landed at about a 45% angle from what I assume is the top and bottom. It is just sitting there. I noticed several weird shapes on it but did not approach close enough to make out what they were supposed to be.

I noticed several weird shapes on it but did not approach close enough to make out what they were supposed to be.

summary: Explanation:  Birds - Possible
description:
3 spheres were directly above us.
Formation: Equilateral Triangle
​Movement: Synchronized orbital spinning while traveling as a unit
​Sound: Silent
​Sky Conditions: Clear
​
On 5/6 at approximately 12:41pm, I observed three distinct objects in a clear sky. The objects were initially positioned close to my location, providing a clear view of their movement. The objects maintained a strict triangle formation while simultaneously spinning in a circular motion around a common center point. This rotation was exceptionally smooth and showed no signs of turbulence or erratic shifting.
​Flight Path & Behavior: Unlike conventional aircraft or drones, these objects moved as a single, cohesive unit. After the initial close-range sighting, the formation began to move away from our position at a steady pace. They continued their synchronized rotation until they eventually disappeared into the distance.
​Acoustics: The event was completely silent. There was no rotor noise, jet propulsion, or humming typically associated with drones or helicopters.
​Flight Dynamics: I have ruled out birds or standard consumer drones due to the perfect geometric formation and the high level of synchronization in…

summary: Ball of light moving straight up before stopping and fading away
description:
A ball of light appeared up from what on a map is the middle of josdalsbreen glacier. Around the highest point.
It rose up in the sky moving quicker than a plane or satellite but much slower than a shooting star it climbed maintaining its colour as shape before stopping on one place and then just fading out.
The glacier is hundreds of square km of nothingness.

summary: Four different colored lights, appearing and disappearing in a small area of sky. Sometimes showing up large/ bright before vanishing
description: Around 8:25 PM, I took one of my dogs outside for a walk before getting ready for bed. As is usual for me, I scanned over the night sky to look at the stars and planes. That's when I noticed in the West sky, a yellow orange, and a dark cranberry red light moving approximately south. I watched them for a few seconds before they seemed to vanish. I then saw an off white light appear somewhat higher than the first lights, that also moved and then vanished. I then stood and watched all 3 of these same colors appear and disappear, moving in different directions, and sometimes making sudden sharp turns, as well as sometimes appearing as a larger, brighter pale yellow before disappearing, for about 5 minutes before going inside to let the dog in and grab my phone. While I was watching, I also noticed that much further up and to the right of the main area of activity, there was a fourth light that was much fainter, and twinkled in several different colors like a star. I believed it was a star until I noticed that it was very slowly and casually moving up, down, and right in it's own sort of small area. After coming back out with my phone, I observed all 4 lights for about another 10…

summary: I was sitting looking at the sky watching two lights thinking they were planets.
description:
I was sitting looking at the sky watching two very bright lights thinking they were planets but with a brightness different from what we had seen before, when I noticed they started to move slowly, gained speed very quickly, and disappeared.
Original report in Portuguese:
Estava sentado olhando para o céu olhando duas luzes muito fortes achando que era planetas mas com brilho diferente do que já tinhamos visto, quando percebi começaram a se mover devagar, pegaram velocidade muito rápido e sumiu.

summary: Bright blue-white orb zipped low and silent NW–SE, far faster than jets or aircraft; not a meteor or reflection.
description:
Foggy Land, Clear Sky.
It's a clear night sky with the moon shining bright. Stars visible. I know what shooting stars look like (I see them almost every night on clear nights, especially summer nights) but this was way too low to be a shooting star, and moving way too fast to be a plane or helicopter. I was walking to my car, and I noticed a very bright light-blue/white light in the corner of my eye. I looked up just in time to see it zip away until I couldn't see it anymore. It wasn't light reflection from passing cars, because the road I was near runs directly east to west, and the orb was traveling northwest to southeast. Completely silent. I've seen the Blue Angels at airshows growing up, and I understand they're moving somewhere around 150mph when doing low passes over crowds, and this orb made those F-18's look like turtles. It was probably flying even lower than when those F-18's do crowd flyovers. Very bright, and very very very quick.

summary: Whilst traveling along the m27 towards eastleigh airport direction I saw a yellow to orange flash
description:
Hi come across this page so thought I would post, was traveling along the m27 Southampton close to Eastleigh airport the other day when I see a fireball in sky literally for a split second, fortunately I have a dashcam which going back and viewing it appears to be white.
When slowed and zoomed it looks as if there is a solid white line appear with a white ball shaped object, it appears to go through the line down and come out at left of the line and disappear.
Ive done my checks no aircraft in air 10 mins before and after also being an airport would not likely of been a drone, I am mystified by what it was and really want an explanation not sure if could be lightning but was orange yellow to the naked eye.

summary: Hypersonic blinking green light
description:
Time of Sighting: Approximately 00:10 local time (Kuwait)
Duration of Sighting: About 15 seconds (initial streak was brief, then observed longer while tracking it)
Witnesses: myself and my wife
My wife and I observed a fast-moving aerial object from our hotel room window, initially facing south. It first appeared as a bright horizontal streak across the sky, similar to a meteor entering the atmosphere. I immediately moved closer to the window to track it.
As I followed its path, the object noticeably slowed down. At this point, I observed a steady blinking green light, which appeared on what would be the correct (starboard) side for a conventional aircraft. However, there was no visible red port light, white strobe, or tail light that I could detect. After slowing, the object then accelerated rapidly again and made a sharp turn to the north before disappearing from view.
The speed was extraordinary—estimated at Mach 2 or possibly Mach 3 based on my experience. I am a qualified F-18 pilot and am very familiar with high-performance military and civilian aircraft appearances, speeds, and lighting at night. Conventional jets at those speeds would produce a visible sonic boom…

It was a circular object, with flashing lights in blue and white. It seemed to be hovering in the air, and then it disappeared at an incredible speed. I stood there, frozen, trying to understand what I had seen.

summary: Shape with pinkish/purple nodes
description: Observed a solo craft moving at an extremely high speed from the North, transitioning East/Southeast. The object emitted a loud, rhythmic mechanical humming/vibration captured on my home security audio. It featured distinct pink/purple orbs, or nodes, on each side, which do not match standard FAA navigation lights. While the object was overhead, my dog became non-responsive and failed to recall despite repeated commands. The craft then performed a rapid, vertical nose-dive behind the tree line past Lafayette Street toward the Great Swamp area. No sound of impact was heard.

summary: Seen lights, not moving then started moving, lights flashed then lights underneath in a circular motion
description: Came outside I seen it first thought what’s that. Left it didn’t say anything, my mum then came out and said what’s that in the sky we watched it for a while. The object wasn’t moving at first then we noticed it moved slightly, then it moved faster and what we saw we still can’t understand now, we’ve looked at the Elon musk satellite but to us it’s not that. The lights that we saw it seemed to drop to another level and flicker in a circular motion. We came out half an hour later and it was gone

summary: 4 Bright lights moving actoss the sky slowly
description:
I was lying in bed. Looked out of the window. I saw one extremely bright light which was moving slowly across the sky. Then I saw 3 others (less bright) NW of the first light moving in the same way.
They seemed to be too dynamic for planets & much slower than a plane & no tail for a comet or shooting star. I watched for about 20 minutes. Eventually they drifted behind heavier cloud cover.
There was more nocturnal animal noise at this time.

summary: Lights would collide and multiply
description:
Outside seeing our friends bunny and cats and I decided to look up and saw one of these lights and then they would collide and multiply
Very cloudy night, was no stars visible and you could tell the difference from when an aircraft would fly by and then this. We also checked flight radars and any spotlights near the area. I’ve seen a video like this online but nobody has an explanation it really did give me full body chills. Very far out in the country lots of fields and dirt roads

summary: Long cigar shape with six lights moving very fast.
description:
Standing front of my house there was a lot of military jets overhead and as I looked up coming from the north there was a cigar shape thing going very fast, too fast to get my cell phone out of my pocket to take a picture.
The military jets seemed like they were trying to coral this thing, it flew right over head about 25,000 feet. The fighter jets were about 30,000 feet or higher and then it went straight up and out of sight. The military jets were still flying around a hour later. There were about 8 fighter jets. I am close to Washington, DC so I thought it was strange to see a lot of military jets, and Reagan airport is close by.

summary: Large light in sky emitting a bright light directly down towards the ground
description:
We noticed it immediately in the sky. It was a really large bright object emitting a bright light directly down towards the ground. At first it appears not to be moving. It was massive - much bigger than a plane as we could see lots of planes flying near it and they were tiny in comparison. We pulled over our van and then the object began to move and the light dim slightly. Then all of a sudden the light turned off and we could see a very dim light for about 30 seconds before it turned off suddenly. We have a video.
NUFORC Note:
We requested the video but received no response.

summary: Obs for 30 min, video 28 min; wht/org lighting; magnification = multiple shapes spinning opposite; altitude changes; almost full moon
description:
First saw object in the distance approaching from the north as I walked to our mailbox down the street; I didn’t think much as it was a normal landing route for Mather Airfield. Walking back home looked at it again and noticed its lighting had changed from what I thought were two or three forward lights to just one and it was traveling slower than normal air traffic – it did not look right. Grabbed smartphone and my wife and I went onto porch facing north. Almost a full moon to our 2 o’clock position with clouds starting to form. Object was higher and to our left of the rising moon and Jupiter, both of which were bright.
No aircraft at that location was on FlightAware. Object now appeared higher. Our naked eyes could see the light appearing to be flickering. Started video recording on smartphone and narrated what we were seeing. Unlike any aircraft or satellite that travels in a straight line, this object kept changing multiple directions in an aeronautical manner not familiar to me. Thought it might be a weather balloon being blown in the atmosphere. Once magnified with the video, it was not a balloon.
It appeared to be one object spinning made of at least two shapes spinning in…

Unlike any aircraft or satellite that travels in a straight line, this object kept changing multiple directions in an aeronautical manner not familiar to me. Thought it might be a weather balloon being blown in the atmosphere. Once magnified with the video, it was not a balloon.
It appeared to be one object spinning made of at least two shapes spinning in…

summary: Flash of light, black circle in center of light, then darted off and upwards
description:
I was driving down plant street from the 429. I believe I was facing west. The sky illuminated right above my eye line like a flash of lightening, but it stayed lit in the middle of the sky. Amongst the illumination was a pure black circle. Almost looked like it was just missing light there in a perfect hole. The instant I even realized what I was looking at it darted off at an upward angle leaving a blue white and green looking trail that vanished as soon as it appeared. I’ve lived in Florida my whole life and watch rockets launch all the time but I’ve never seen anything move that fast. It was almost inconceivable. The entire interaction last maybe a second and a half.
It almost looked fake. Like vfx in real time in the sky. There was zero trace of anything that had flown through the sky.

summary: Orbs falling
description: I see these lights like stars that just appear in the night sky then fall to the horizon. They appear out of nowhere get brighter as they fall then just disappear. Sometimes one then two or three appear at the same time. They kind of fall not in a straight line but drift. Sometimes they cross paths as they fall. Always around 3:30 4:00 AM in the morning. Consistent most nights. Some nights I may see one two three. Other nights they keep appearing for hours untill it gets light. Always in the same area of the sky no plane or blinking lights flying in the area so it's not flares. I work night shift. I get home around 3:00 am I go to my chair on my hill in the woods and look for them most every night.I expect to see some most every night.

summary: Stationary oval UFO with racetrack midsection and three dark dots hovered ~300 ft, glowing fluorescent green, then blinked out.
description: First off wow!! some neighbors and I were in the common room at our condo residence last night and we were playing Yahtzee to bring in the new year, there was zero alcohol drank as we are mostly disabled or elderly and I am the youngest in here at 58, anyway I called it quits around 10 p.m. and went back to my apartment, at around approximately 1 a.m. I went out back from our condo and went to have a smoke, it was cold (about -12 degrees) so I hadn't expected to stay any longer than the time it takes to have a smoke and when I was nearly done I felt something strange come over me, not sure how to explain it but I looked up towards the sky (overcast) and all of a sudden I saw it, a U.F.O. I mean it certainly wasn't a glow in the dark drone It was hovering maybe 300 ft (I'm not great at guessing approx. distances) it appeared to be just stationary, my eyes were focused intensely for a brief what felt like a minute at least but probably 10 seconds or less but I can tell you with utter clarity that what I saw was no man made object it was just floating up there, with no real movement really almost like it knew I was watching it or it wanted me to see it! It remained stationary until…

I mean it certainly wasn't a glow in the dark drone It was hovering maybe 300 ft (I'm not great at guessing approx. distances) it appeared to be just stationary, my eyes were focused intensely for a brief what felt like a minute at least but probably 10 seconds or less but I can tell you with utter clarity that what I saw was no man made object it was just floating up there, with no real movement really almost like it knew I was watching it or it wanted me to see it! It remained stationary until…

summary: It was moving from south to northwest, with the naked eye it was a diamond shape and looked like it was on fire,in the end go in space
description: We have a recording, the camera is not very good because it was recorded with a cell phone, we have 2 recordings from 2 angles recorded, while we were on the terrace, we saw suddenly, a light that shone suddenly, with the naked eye we saw a burning diamond shape, it did not make any sound, nor did it leave a trace behind, it burned like a large confiscated diamond, when we recorded with a cell phone it looked like a glowing orbit, and the colors were iridescent, the video lasts 2 minutes and 11/13 seconds, recorded at 00:44 hours our local time, 1.1.2026., it moved from the direction of the sea, (south), towards the land (northwest), the speed was like a kite, it did not follow the line properly, it seemed to be spinning while it moved, as it moved away towards the northwest, it began to accelerate and reduce its light, until it went towards space where it disappeared.

summary: Explanation:  Chinese Lantern - Probable
description:
Orbs moved silently from NW to SE at medium speed in train formation over a period of ten minutes.
I walked onto my pool deck just after midnight and saw two orange orbs moving toward the southeast. No sound, no navigation lights, traveling in a straight line. Slight pulsation in brightness. Called for wife to observe and grabbed my phone for video. Orbs would proceed SE and begin flickering before fading from view. The stream continued for approximately ten minutes, with all following the same behavior as the lead objects, decreasing brightness and fading from view. I consulted Heavens Above website for satellite passes, and of course it was too late at night for any. Checked my Flight Radar 24 app for local radar contacts and found none. They all moved at a speed I would characterize as general aviation speed (I am a pilot), possibly 80-100 knots. No altitude estimate, but they weren't that high, I think. Maybe a couple thousand feet? I captured good video of most of them. The last one observed followed a different, more easterly track before disappearing.
